3274!> A routine to set eta_pred and the running time integral of uhbt and vhbt.
32750subroutine btloop_eta_predictor(n, dtbt, ubt, vbt, eta, ubt_int, vbt_int, uhbt, vhbt, uhbt0, vhbt0, &
32760 uhbt_int, vhbt_int, BTCL_u, BTCL_v, Datu, Datv, &
32770 eta_IC, eta_src, eta_pred, isv, iev, jsv, jev, &
3278 integral_BT_cont, use_BT_cont, G, US, CS)
3279 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure
3280 type(barotropic_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
3281 integer, intent(in) :: n !< The current step in loop of timesteps
3282 real, intent(in) :: dtbt !< The barotropic time step [T ~> s]
3283 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3284 ubt !< The zonal barotropic velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
3285 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3286 vbt !< The zonal barotropic velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
3287 real, target, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3288 eta !< The barotropic free surface height anomaly or column mass
3289 !! anomaly [H ~> m or kg m-2]
3290 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3291 ubt_int !< The running time integral of ubt over the time steps [L ~> m].
3292 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3293 vbt_int !< The running time integral of vbt over the time steps [L ~> m].
3294 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3295 uhbt0 !< The difference between the sum of the layer zonal thickness
3296 !! fluxes and the barotropic thickness flux using the same
3297 !! velocity [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1].
3298 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3299 vhbt0 !< The difference between the sum of the layer meridional
3300 !! thickness fluxes and the barotropic thickness flux using
3301 !! the same velocities [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1].
3302 type(local_BT_cont_u_type), dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3303 BTCL_u !< A repackaged version of the u-point information in BT_cont.
3304 type(local_BT_cont_v_type), dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3305 BTCL_v !< A repackaged version of the v-point information in BT_cont.
3306 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3307 Datu !< Basin depth at u-velocity grid points times the y-grid
3308 !! spacing [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
3309 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3310 Datv !< Basin depth at v-velocity grid points times the x-grid
3311 !! spacing [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
3312 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3313 eta_IC !< A local copy of the initial 2-D eta field (eta_in) [H ~> m or kg m-2]
3314 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3315 eta_src !< The source of eta per barotropic timestep [H ~> m or kg m-2].
3316 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3317 uhbt !< The zonal barotropic thickness fluxes [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1].
3318 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3319 vhbt !< The meridional barotropic thickness fluxes [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1].
3320 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3321 uhbt_int !< The running time integral of uhbt over the time steps [H L2 ~> m3 or kg].
3322 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3323 vhbt_int !< The running time integral of vhbt over the time steps [H L2 ~> m3 or kg].
3324 real, target, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3325 eta_pred !< A predictor value of eta [H ~> m or kg m-2] like eta.
3326 integer, intent(in) :: isv !< The starting i-index of eta_pred to calculate
3327 integer, intent(in) :: iev !< The ending i-index of eta_pred to calculate
3328 integer, intent(in) :: jsv !< The starting j-index of eta_pred to calculate
3329 integer, intent(in) :: jev !< The ending j-index of eta_pred to calculate
3330 logical, intent(in) :: integral_BT_cont !< If true, update the barotropic continuity equation directly
3331 !! from the initial condition using the time-integrated barotropic velocity.
3332 logical, intent(in) :: use_BT_cont !< If true, use the information in the BT_cont_type to determine
3333 !! barotropic transports as a function of the barotropic velocities.
3334 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
3335
3336 integer :: i, j
3337
33380 if (integral_BT_cont) then
33390 do concurrent (j=jsv-1:jev+1, I=isv-2:iev+1)
33400 uhbt_int(I,j) = find_uhbt(ubt_int(I,j) + dtbt*ubt(I,j), BTCL_u(I,j)) + n*dtbt*uhbt0(I,j)
3341 enddo
33420 do concurrent (J=jsv-2:jev+1, i=isv-1:iev+1)
33430 vhbt_int(i,J) = find_vhbt(vbt_int(i,J) + dtbt*vbt(i,J), BTCL_v(i,J)) + n*dtbt*vhbt0(i,J)
3344 enddo
33450 do concurrent (j=jsv-1:jev+1, i=isv-1:iev+1)
3346 eta_pred(i,j) = (eta_IC(i,j) + n*eta_src(i,j)) + CS%IareaT_OBCmask(i,j) * &
33470 ((uhbt_int(I-1,j) - uhbt_int(I,j)) + (vhbt_int(i,J-1) - vhbt_int(i,J)))
3348 enddo
33490 elseif (use_BT_cont) then
33500 do concurrent (j=jsv-1:jev+1, I=isv-2:iev+1)
33510 uhbt(I,j) = find_uhbt(ubt(I,j), BTCL_u(I,j)) + uhbt0(I,j)
3352 enddo
33530 do concurrent (J=jsv-2:jev+1, i=isv-1:iev+1)
33540 vhbt(i,J) = find_vhbt(vbt(i,J), BTCL_v(i,J)) + vhbt0(i,J)
3355 enddo
33560 do concurrent (j=jsv-1:jev+1, i=isv-1:iev+1)
3357 eta_pred(i,j) = (eta(i,j) + eta_src(i,j)) + (dtbt * CS%IareaT_OBCmask(i,j)) * &
33580 ((uhbt(I-1,j) - uhbt(I,j)) + (vhbt(i,J-1) - vhbt(i,J)))
3359 enddo
3360 else
33610 do concurrent (j=jsv-1:jev+1, i=isv-1:iev+1)
3362 eta_pred(i,j) = (eta(i,j) + eta_src(i,j)) + (dtbt * CS%IareaT_OBCmask(i,j)) * &
3363 (((Datu(I-1,j)*ubt(I-1,j) + uhbt0(I-1,j)) - &
3364 (Datu(I,j)*ubt(I,j) + uhbt0(I,j))) + &
3365 ((Datv(i,J-1)*vbt(i,J-1) + vhbt0(i,J-1)) - &
33660 (Datv(i,J)*vbt(i,J) + vhbt0(i,J))))
3367 enddo
3368 endif
3369
33700end subroutine btloop_eta_predictor
3371
33725760subroutine btloop_find_PF(PFu, PFv, isv, iev, jsv, jev, eta_PF_BT, eta_PF, &
33735760 gtot_N, gtot_S, gtot_E, gtot_W, dgeo_de, find_etaav, &
33745760 wt_accel2_n, eta_sum, v_first, G, US, CS)
3375 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
3376 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
3377 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3378 PFu !< The anomalous zonal pressure force acceleration [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3379 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3380 PFv !< The meridional pressure force acceleration [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3381 integer, intent(in) :: isv !< The starting i-index of eta being set in ths loop
3382 integer, intent(in) :: iev !< The ending i-index of eta_pred being set in ths loop
3383 integer, intent(in) :: jsv !< The starting j-index of eta_pred being set in ths loop
3384 integer, intent(in) :: jev !< The ending j-index of eta_pred being set in ths loop
3385 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3386 eta_PF_BT !< The eta array (either the SSH anomaly or column mass anomaly) that
3387 !! determines the barotropic pressure force [H ~> m or kg m-2]
3388 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3389 eta_PF !< The input 2-D eta field (either SSH anomaly or column mass anomaly)
3390 !! that was used to calculate the input pressure gradient
3391 !! accelerations [H ~> m or kg m-2].
3392 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3393 gtot_N !< The effective total reduced gravity used to relate free surface height
3394 !! deviations to pressure forces (including GFS and baroclinic contributions)
3395 !! in the barotropic momentum equations half a grid-point to the north of a
3396 !! thickness point [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2].
3397 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3398 gtot_S !< The effective total reduced gravity used to relate free surface height
3399 !! deviations to pressure forces (including GFS and baroclinic contributions)
3400 !! in the barotropic momentum equations half a grid-point to the south of a
3401 !! thickness point [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2].
3402 !! (See Hallberg, J Comp Phys 1997 for a discussion of gtot_E and gtot_W.)
3403 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3404 gtot_E !< The effective total reduced gravity used to relate free surface height
3405 !! deviations to pressure forces (including GFS and baroclinic contributions)
3406 !! in the barotropic momentum equations half a grid-point to the east of a
3407 !! thickness point [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2].
3408 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3409 gtot_W !< The effective total reduced gravity used to relate free surface height
3410 !! deviations to pressure forces (including GFS and baroclinic contributions)
3411 !! in the barotropic momentum equations half a grid-point to the west of a
3412 !! thickness point [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2].
3413 !! (See Hallberg, J Comp Phys 1997 for a discussion of gtot_E and gtot_W.)
3414 real, intent(in) :: dgeo_de !< The constant of proportionality between geopotential and
3415 !! sea surface height [nondim]. It is of order 1, but for stability this
3416 !! may be made larger than the physical problem would suggest.
3417 logical, intent(in) :: find_etaav !< If true, diagnose the time mean value of eta
3418 real, intent(in) :: wt_accel2_n !< The weighting value of wt_accel2 at step n.
3419 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3420 eta_sum !< A weighted running sum of eta summed across the timesteps [H ~> m or kg m-2]
3421 logical, intent(in) :: v_first !< If true, update the v-velocity first with the present loop iteration
3422 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
3423
3424 ! Local variables
3425 integer :: i, j, js_u, je_u, is_v, ie_v
3426
3427 ! Ensure that the extra points used for the temporally staggered Coriolis terms are updated.
34285760 if (v_first) then
34292880 is_v = isv-1 ; ie_v = iev+1 ; js_u = jsv ; je_u = jev
3430 else
34312880 is_v = isv ; ie_v = iev ; js_u = jsv-1 ; je_u = jev+1
3432 endif
3433
34345760 do concurrent (j=js_u:je_u, I=isv-1:iev)
3435 PFu(I,j) = (((eta_PF_BT(i,j)-eta_PF(i,j))*gtot_E(i,j)) - &
3436 ((eta_PF_BT(i+1,j)-eta_PF(i+1,j))*gtot_W(i+1,j))) * &
343712470400 dgeo_de * CS%IdxCu(I,j)
3438 enddo
3439
3440282240 do concurrent (J=jsv-1:jev, i=is_v:ie_v)
3441 PFv(i,J) = (((eta_PF_BT(i,j)-eta_PF(i,j))*gtot_N(i,j)) - &
3442 ((eta_PF_BT(i,j+1)-eta_PF(i,j+1))*gtot_S(i,j+1))) * &
344312481920 dgeo_de * CS%IdyCv(i,J)
3444 enddo
3445
34465760 if (find_etaav .and. (abs(wt_accel2_n) > 0.0)) then
3447129600 do concurrent (j=G%jsc:G%jec, i=G%isc:G%iec)
34485198400 eta_sum(i,j) = eta_sum(i,j) + wt_accel2_n * eta_PF_BT(i,j)
3449 enddo
3450 endif
3451
34525760end subroutine btloop_find_PF
3453
3454!> This routine adds a dynamic pressure force based on the temporal changes in the predicted value
3455!! of eta, perhaps as an effective divergence damping to emulate the rigidity of an ice-sheet.
34560subroutine btloop_add_dyn_PF(PFu, PFv, eta_pred, eta, dyn_coef_eta, p_surf_dyn, &
3457 isv, iev, jsv, jev, v_first, G, US, CS)
3458 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
3459 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
3460 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3461 PFu !< The anomalous zonal pressure force acceleration [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3462 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3463 PFv !< The meridional pressure force acceleration [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3464 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3465 eta_pred !< The updated eta field (either SSH anomaly or column mass anomaly) that is
3466 !! used to estimate the divergence that is to be damped [H ~> m or kg m-2].
3467 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3468 eta !< The previous eta field (either SSH anomaly or column mass anomaly) that is
3469 !! used to estimate the divergence that is to be damped [H ~> m or kg m-2].
3470 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3471 dyn_coef_eta !< The coefficient relating the changes in eta to the dynamic surface pressure
3472 !! under rigid ice [L2 T-2 H-1 ~> m s-2 or m4 s-2 kg-1].
3473 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3474 p_surf_dyn !< A dynamic surface pressure under rigid ice [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2].
3475 integer, intent(in) :: isv !< The starting i-index of eta being set in ths loop
3476 integer, intent(in) :: iev !< The ending i-index of eta_pred being set in ths loop
3477 integer, intent(in) :: jsv !< The starting j-index of eta_pred being set in ths loop
3478 integer, intent(in) :: jev !< The ending j-index of eta_pred being set in ths loop
3479 logical, intent(in) :: v_first !< If true, update the v-velocity first with the present loop iteration
3480 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
3481
3482 ! Local variables
3483 integer :: i, j, js_u, je_u, is_v, ie_v
3484
3485 ! Ensure that the extra points used for the temporally staggered Coriolis terms are updated.
34860 if (v_first) then
34870 is_v = isv-1 ; ie_v = iev+1 ; js_u = jsv ; je_u = jev
3488 else
34890 is_v = isv ; ie_v = iev ; js_u = jsv-1 ; je_u = jev+1
3490 endif
3491
3492 ! Use the change in eta to estimate the flow divergence and dynamic pressure.
34930 do concurrent (j=jsv-1:jev+1, i=isv-1:iev+1)
34940 p_surf_dyn(i,j) = dyn_coef_eta(i,j) * (eta_pred(i,j) - eta(i,j))
3495 enddo
3496
34970 do concurrent (j=js_u:je_u, I=isv-1:iev)
34980 PFu(I,j) = PFu(I,j) + (p_surf_dyn(i,j) - p_surf_dyn(i+1,j)) * CS%IdxCu(I,j)
3499 enddo
35000 do concurrent (J=jsv-1:jev, i=is_v:ie_v)
35010 PFv(i,J) = PFv(i,J) + (p_surf_dyn(i,j) - p_surf_dyn(i,j+1)) * CS%IdyCv(i,J)
3502 enddo
3503
35040end subroutine btloop_add_dyn_PF
3505
3506!> Update meridional velocity.
35075760subroutine btloop_update_v(dtbt, ubt, vbt, v_accel_bt, &
35085760 Cor_v, PFv, is_v, ie_v, Js_v, Je_v, f_4_v, &
35095760 bt_rem_v, BT_force_v, Cor_ref_v, Rayleigh_v, &
3510 wt_accel_n, G, US, CS, Cor_bracket_bug)
3511 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
3512 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
3513 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3514 ubt !< The zonal barotropic velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
3515 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3516 vbt !< The meridional barotropic velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
3517 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3518 v_accel_bt !< The difference between the meridional acceleration from the
3519 !! barotropic calculation and BT_force_v [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3520 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3521 Cor_v !< The meridional Coriolis acceleration [L T-2 ~> m s-2]
3522 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3523 PFv !< The meridional pressure force acceleration [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3524 real, dimension(4,SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3525 f_4_v !< The terms giving the contribution to the Coriolis acceleration at a meridional
3526 !! velocity point from the neighboring meridional velocity anomalies [T-1 ~> s-1].
3527 !! These are the products of thicknesses at u points and appropriately staggered
3528 !! averaged pseudo potential vorticities, but with sufficiently smooth topography
3529 !! they are approximately f / 4. The 4 values on the innermost loop are for
3530 !! u-velocities to the southwest, southeast, northwest and northeast.
3531 integer, intent(in) :: is_v !< The starting i-index of the range of v-point values to calculate
3532 integer, intent(in) :: ie_v !< The ending i-index of the range of v-point values to calculate
3533 integer, intent(in) :: Js_v !< The starting j-index of the range of v-point values to calculate
3534 integer, intent(in) :: Je_v !< The ending j-index of the range of v-point values to calculate
3535 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3536 bt_rem_v !< The fraction of the barotropic meridional velocity that
3537 !! remains after a time step, the rest being lost to bottom
3538 !! drag [nondim]. bt_rem_v is between 0 and 1.
3539 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3540 BT_force_v !< The vertical average of all of the v-accelerations that are
3541 !! not explicitly included in the barotropic equation [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3542 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3543 Cor_ref_v !< The meridional barotropic Coriolis acceleration due
3544 !! to the reference velocities [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3545 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3546 Rayleigh_v !< A Rayleigh drag timescale operating at v-points for drag parameterizations
3547 !! that introduced directly into the barotropic solver rather than coming
3548 !! in via the visc_rem_v arrays from the layered equations [T-1 ~> s-1]
3549 real, intent(in) :: wt_accel_n !< The raw or relative weights of each of the barotropic timesteps
3550 !! in determining the average accelerations [nondim]
3551 real, intent(in) :: dtbt !< The barotropic time step [T ~> s].
3552 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
3553 logical, optional, intent(in) :: Cor_bracket_bug !< If present and true, use an order of operations that is
3554 !! not bitwise rotationally symmetric in the meridional Coriolis term
3555
3556 ! Local variables
3557 logical :: use_bracket_bug
3558 integer :: i, j
3559
35605760 use_bracket_bug = .false. ; if (present(Cor_bracket_bug)) use_bracket_bug = Cor_bracket_bug
3561
3562 ! The bracket bug only applies if v is second, use ioff to check.
35635760 if (use_bracket_bug) then
35640 do concurrent (J=Js_v:Je_v, i=is_v:ie_v)
3565 Cor_v(i,J) = -1.0*(((f_4_v(1,i,J) * ubt(I-1,j)) + (f_4_v(2,i,J) * ubt(I,j))) + &
35660 ((f_4_v(4,i,J) * ubt(I,j+1)) + (f_4_v(3,i,J) * ubt(I-1,j+1)))) - Cor_ref_v(i,J)
3567 enddo
3568 else
3569282240 do concurrent (J=Js_v:Je_v, i=is_v:ie_v)
3570 Cor_v(i,J) = -1.0*(((f_4_v(1,i,J) * ubt(I-1,j)) + (f_4_v(4,i,J) * ubt(I,j+1))) + &
357112481920 ((f_4_v(2,i,J) * ubt(I,j)) + (f_4_v(3,i,J) * ubt(I-1,j+1)))) - Cor_ref_v(i,J)
3572 enddo
3573 endif
3574
3575 ! This updates the v-velocity, except at OBC points.
3576282240 do concurrent (J=Js_v:Je_v, i=is_v:ie_v)
3577 vbt(i,J) = bt_rem_v(i,J) * (vbt(i,J) + &
357812199680 dtbt * ((BT_force_v(i,J) + Cor_v(i,J)) + PFv(i,J)))
357912481920 if (abs(vbt(i,J)) < CS%vel_underflow) vbt(i,J) = 0.0
3580 enddo
3581
35825760 if (CS%linear_wave_drag) then
35830 do concurrent (J=Js_v:Je_v, i=is_v:ie_v)
3584 v_accel_bt(i,J) = v_accel_bt(i,J) + wt_accel_n * &
35850 ((Cor_v(i,J) + PFv(i,J)) - vbt(i,J)*Rayleigh_v(i,J))
3586 enddo
3587 else
3588282240 do concurrent (J=Js_v:Je_v, i=is_v:ie_v)
358912481920 v_accel_bt(i,J) = v_accel_bt(i,J) + wt_accel_n * (Cor_v(i,J) + PFv(i,J))
3590 enddo
3591 endif
3592
35935760end subroutine btloop_update_v
3594
3595!> Update zonal velocity.
35965760subroutine btloop_update_u(dtbt, ubt, vbt, u_accel_bt, &
35975760 Cor_u, PFu, Is_u, Ie_u, js_u, je_u, f_4_u, &
35985760 bt_rem_u, BT_force_u, Cor_ref_u, Rayleigh_u, &
3599 wt_accel_n, G, US, CS)
3600 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
3601 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
3602 real, intent(in) :: dtbt !< The barotropic time step [T ~> s].
3603 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3604 ubt !< The zonal barotropic velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
3605 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3606 vbt !< The meridional barotropic velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
3607 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3608 u_accel_bt !! The difference between the zonal acceleration from the
3609 !< barotropic calculation and BT_force_v [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3610 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(inout) :: &
3611 Cor_u !< The anomalous zonal Coriolis acceleration [L T-2 ~> m s-2]
3612 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3613 PFu !< The anomalous zonal pressure force acceleration [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3614 integer, intent(in) :: Is_u !< The starting i-index of the range of u-point values to calculate
3615 integer, intent(in) :: Ie_u !< The ending i-index of the range of u-point values to calculate
3616 integer, intent(in) :: js_u !< The starting j-index of the range of u-point values to calculate
3617 integer, intent(in) :: je_u !< The ending j-index of the range of u-point values to calculate
3618 real, dimension(4,SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3619 f_4_u !< The terms giving the contribution to the Coriolis acceleration at a zonal
3620 !! velocity point from the neighboring meridional velocity anomalies [T-1 ~> s-1].
3621 !! These are the products of thicknesses at v points and appropriately staggered
3622 !! averaged pseudo potential vorticities, but with sufficiently smooth topography
3623 !! they are approximately f / 4. The 4 values on the innermost loop are for
3624 !! v-velocities to the southwest, southeast, northwest and northeast.
3625 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3626 bt_rem_u !< The fraction of the barotropic meridional velocity that
3627 !! remains after a time step, the rest being lost to bottom
3628 !! drag [nondim]. bt_rem_v is between 0 and 1.
3629 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3630 BT_force_u !< The vertical average of all of the v-accelerations that are
3631 !! not explicitly included in the barotropic equation [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3632 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3633 Cor_ref_u !< The meridional barotropic Coriolis acceleration due
3634 !! to the reference velocities [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3635 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3636 Rayleigh_u !< A Rayleigh drag timescale operating at u-points for drag parameterizations
3637 !! that introduced directly into the barotropic solver rather than coming
3638 !! in via the visc_rem_u arrays from the layered equations [T-1 ~> s-1].
3639 real, intent(in) :: wt_accel_n !< The raw or relative weights of each of the barotropic timesteps
3640 !! in determining the average accelerations [nondim]
3641 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
3642
3643 ! Local variables
3644 integer :: i, j
3645
3646282240 do concurrent (j=js_u:je_u, I=Is_u:Ie_u)
3647 Cor_u(I,j) = (((f_4_u(4,I,j) * vbt(i+1,J)) + (f_4_u(1,I,j) * vbt(i,J-1))) + &
3648 ((f_4_u(3,I,j) * vbt(i,J)) + (f_4_u(2,I,j) * vbt(i+1,J-1)))) - &
364912188160 Cor_ref_u(I,j)
3650
3651 ubt(I,j) = bt_rem_u(I,j) * (ubt(I,j) + &
365212188160 dtbt * ((BT_force_u(I,j) + Cor_u(I,j)) + PFu(I,j)))
365312470400 if (abs(ubt(I,j)) < CS%vel_underflow) ubt(I,j) = 0.0
3654 enddo
3655
36565760 if (CS%linear_wave_drag) then
36570 do concurrent (j=js_u:je_u, I=Is_u:Ie_u)
3658 u_accel_bt(I,j) = u_accel_bt(I,j) + wt_accel_n * &
36590 ((Cor_u(I,j) + PFu(I,j)) - ubt(I,j)*Rayleigh_u(I,j))
3660 enddo
3661 else
3662282240 do concurrent (j=js_u:je_u, I=Is_u:Ie_u)
366312470400 u_accel_bt(I,j) = u_accel_bt(I,j) + wt_accel_n * (Cor_u(I,j) + PFu(I,j))
3664 enddo
3665 endif
3666
36675760end subroutine btloop_update_u
3668
3669
3670!> Calculate the zonal and meridional velocity from the 3-D velocity.
36711440subroutine btstep_ubt_from_layer(U_in, V_in, wt_u, wt_v, ubt, vbt, G, GV, CS)
3672 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
3673 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
3674 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
3675 real, intent(in) :: U_in(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)) !< The initial (3-D) zonal velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
3676 real, intent(in) :: V_in(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)) !< The initial (3-D) meridional velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
3677 real, intent(in) :: wt_u(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)) !< The normalized weights to be used in calculating
3678 !! zonal barotropic velocities, possibly with sums
3679 !! less than one due to viscous losses [nondim]
3680 real, intent(in) :: wt_v(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)) !< The normalized weights to be used in calculating
3681 !! meridional barotropic velocities, possibly with
3682 !! sums less than one due to viscous losses [nondim]
3683 real, intent(out) :: ubt(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)) !< The zonal barotropic velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
3684 real, intent(out) :: vbt(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)) !< The meridional barotropic velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
3685
3686 ! Local variables
3687 integer :: i, j, k, is, ie, js, je, nz
3688
36891440 is = G%isc ; ie = G%iec ; js = G%jsc ; je = G%jec ; nz = GV%ke
3690
369177760 do concurrent (j=CS%jsdw:CS%jedw, i=CS%isdw-1:CS%iedw)
36923741120 ubt(i,j) = 0.0
3693 enddo
369476320 do concurrent (j=CS%jsdw-1:CS%jedw, i=CS%isdw:CS%iedw)
36953745440 vbt(i,j) = 0.0
3696 enddo
3697
36981440 do concurrent (j=js:je)
3699218880 do k=1,nz
370057600 do concurrent (I=is-1:ie)
370126352000 ubt(I,j) = ubt(I,j) + wt_u(I,j,k) * U_in(I,j,k)
3702 enddo
3703 enddo
370459040 do concurrent (I=is-1:ie)
37052649600 if (abs(ubt(I,j)) < CS%vel_underflow) ubt(I,j) = 0.0
3706 enddo
3707 enddo
37081440 do concurrent (J=js-1:je)
3709222528 do k=1,nz
371059040 do concurrent (i=is:ie)
371126571600 vbt(i,J) = vbt(i,J) + wt_v(i,J,k) * V_in(i,J,k)
3712 enddo
3713 enddo
371460480 do concurrent (i=is:ie)
37152656800 if (abs(vbt(i,J)) < CS%vel_underflow) vbt(i,J) = 0.0
3716 enddo
3717 enddo
3718
37191440end subroutine btstep_ubt_from_layer
3720
3721
3722!> Calculate the zonal and meridional acceleration of each layer due to the barotropic calculation.
37231440subroutine btstep_layer_accel(dt, u_accel_bt, v_accel_bt, pbce, gtot_E, gtot_W, gtot_N, gtot_S, &
37241440 e_anom, G, GV, CS, accel_layer_u, accel_layer_v)
3725 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
3726 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
3727 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
3728 real, intent(in) :: dt !< The time increment to integrate over [T ~> s].
3729 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3730 u_accel_bt !< The difference between the zonal acceleration from the
3731 !! barotropic calculation and BT_force_u [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3732 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3733 v_accel_bt !< The difference between the meridional acceleration from the
3734 !! barotropic calculation and BT_force_v [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3735 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: pbce !< The baroclinic pressure anomaly in each layer
3736 !! due to free surface height anomalies
3737 !! [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2].
3738 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3739 gtot_E !< The effective total reduced gravity used to relate free surface height
3740 !! deviations to pressure forces (including GFS and baroclinic contributions)
3741 !! in the barotropic momentum equations half a grid-point to the east of a
3742 !! thickness point [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2].
3743 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3744 gtot_W !< The effective total reduced gravity used to relate free surface height
3745 !! deviations to pressure forces (including GFS and baroclinic contributions)
3746 !! in the barotropic momentum equations half a grid-point to the west of a
3747 !! thickness point [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2].
3748 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3749 gtot_N !< The effective total reduced gravity used to relate free surface height
3750 !! deviations to pressure forces (including GFS and baroclinic contributions)
3751 !! in the barotropic momentum equations half a grid-point to the north of a
3752 !! thickness point [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2].
3753 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)), intent(in) :: &
3754 gtot_S !< The effective total reduced gravity used to relate free surface height
3755 !! deviations to pressure forces (including GFS and baroclinic contributions)
3756 !! in the barotropic momentum equations half a grid-point to the south of a
3757 !! thickness point [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2].
3758 !! (See Hallberg, J Comp Phys 1997 for a discussion of gtot_E, etc.)
3759 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G)), intent(in) :: &
3760 e_anom !< The anomaly in the sea surface height or column mass
3761 !! averaged between the beginning and end of the time step,
3762 !! relative to eta_PF, with SAL effects included [H ~> m or kg m-2].
3763 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(out) :: accel_layer_u !< The zonal acceleration of each layer due
3764 !! to the barotropic calculation [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3765 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(out) :: accel_layer_v !< The meridional acceleration of each layer
3766 !! due to the barotropic calculation [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3767
3768 ! Local variables
3769 real :: accel_underflow ! An acceleration that is so small it should be zeroed out [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
3770 real :: Idt ! The inverse of dt [T-1 ~> s-1].
3771 integer :: i, j, k, is, ie, js, je, nz
3772
37731440 is = G%isc ; ie = G%iec ; js = G%jsc ; je = G%jec ; nz = GV%ke
3774
37751440 Idt = 1.0 / dt
37761440 accel_underflow = CS%vel_underflow * Idt
3777
3778 ! Now calculate each layer's accelerations.
37791440 do concurrent (k=1:nz, j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
3780 accel_layer_u(I,j,k) = (u_accel_bt(I,j) - &
3781 (((pbce(i+1,j,k) - gtot_W(i+1,j)) * e_anom(i+1,j)) - &
378226136000 ((pbce(i,j,k) - gtot_E(i,j)) * e_anom(i,j))) * CS%IdxCu(I,j) )
378326490336 if (abs(accel_layer_u(I,j,k)) < accel_underflow) accel_layer_u(I,j,k) = 0.0
3784 enddo
37851440 do concurrent (k=1:nz, J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
3786 accel_layer_v(i,J,k) = (v_accel_bt(i,J) - &
3787 (((pbce(i,j+1,k) - gtot_S(i,j+1)) * e_anom(i,j+1)) - &
378826352000 ((pbce(i,j,k) - gtot_N(i,j)) * e_anom(i,j))) * CS%IdyCv(i,J) )
378926709168 if (abs(accel_layer_v(i,J,k)) < accel_underflow) accel_layer_v(i,J,k) = 0.0
3790 enddo
3791
37921440end subroutine btstep_layer_accel
3793
3794!> This subroutine automatically determines an optimal value for dtbt based on some state of the ocean. Either pbce or
3795!! gtot_est is required to calculate gravitational acceleration. Column thickness can be estimated using BT_cont, eta,
3796!! and SSH_add (default=0), with priority given in that order. The subroutine sets CS%dtbt_max and CS%dtbt.
379726subroutine set_dtbt(G, GV, US, CS, pbce, gtot_est, BT_cont, eta, SSH_add, Time)
3798 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
3799 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
3800 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
3801 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
3802 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
3803 optional, intent(in) :: pbce !< The baroclinic pressure anomaly in each layer due to free
3804 !! surface height anomalies [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2].
3805 real, optional, intent(in) :: gtot_est !< An estimate of the total gravitational acceleration
3806 !! [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2].
3807 type(BT_cont_type), optional, pointer :: BT_cont !< A structure with elements that describe the effective open
3808 !! face areas as a function of barotropic flow.
3809 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G)), &
3810 optional, intent(in) :: eta !< The barotropic free surface height anomaly or column mass
3811 !! anomaly [H ~> m or kg m-2].
3812 real, optional, intent(in) :: SSH_add !< An additional contribution to SSH to provide a margin of
3813 !! error when calculating the external wave speed [Z ~> m].
3814 type(time_type), optional, intent(in) :: Time !< Model time at the beginning of the baroclinic time step.
3815
3816 ! Local variables
3817 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G)) :: &
381828 gtot_E, & ! gtot_X is the effective total reduced gravity used to relate
381928 gtot_W, & ! free surface height deviations to pressure forces (including
382028 gtot_N, & ! GFS and baroclinic contributions) in the barotropic momentum
382128 gtot_S ! equations half a grid-point in the X-direction (X is N, S, E, or W)
3822 ! from the thickness point [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2].
3823 ! (See Hallberg, J Comp Phys 1997 for a discussion.)
3824 real, dimension(SZIBS_(G),SZJ_(G)) :: &
382514 Datu ! Basin depth at u-velocity grid points times the y-grid
3826 ! spacing [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
3827 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJBS_(G)) :: &
382814 Datv ! Basin depth at v-velocity grid points times the x-grid
3829 ! spacing [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
3830 real :: det_de ! The partial derivative due to self-attraction and loading
3831 ! of the reference geopotential with the sea surface height [nondim].
3832 ! This is typically ~0.09 or less.
3833 real :: dgeo_de ! The constant of proportionality between geopotential and
3834 ! sea surface height [nondim]. It is a nondimensional number of
3835 ! order 1. For stability, this may be made larger
3836 ! than physical problem would suggest.
3837 real :: add_SSH ! An additional contribution to SSH to provide a margin of error
3838 ! when calculating the external wave speed [Z ~> m].
3839 real :: min_max_dt2 ! The square of the minimum value of the largest stable barotropic
3840 ! timesteps [T2 ~> s2]
3841 real :: dtbt_max ! The maximum barotropic timestep [T ~> s]
3842 real :: Idt_max2 ! The squared inverse of the local maximum stable
3843 ! barotropic time step [T-2 ~> s-2].
3844 logical :: use_BT_cont
3845 type(memory_size_type) :: MS
3846 character(len=200) :: mesg
3847 integer :: yr, mon, day, hr, minute, sec
3848 integer :: i, j, k, is, ie, js, je, nz
3849
385014 if (.not.CS%module_is_initialized) call MOM_error(FATAL, &
38510 "set_dtbt: Module MOM_barotropic must be initialized before it is used.")
3852
385314 if (.not.CS%split) return
385414 is = G%isc ; ie = G%iec ; js = G%jsc ; je = G%jec ; nz = GV%ke
385514 MS%isdw = G%isd ; MS%iedw = G%ied ; MS%jsdw = G%jsd ; MS%jedw = G%jed
3856
3857
385814 if (.not.(present(pbce) .or. present(gtot_est))) call MOM_error(FATAL, &
38590 "set_dtbt: Either pbce or gtot_est must be present.")
3860
386114 add_SSH = 0.0 ; if (present(SSH_add)) add_SSH = SSH_add
3862
386314 use_BT_cont = .false.
386414 if (present(BT_cont)) use_BT_cont = (associated(BT_cont))
3865
3866 !$omp target enter data map(alloc: gtot_E, gtot_W, gtot_N, gtot_S, Datu, Datv)
386714 if (use_BT_cont) then
38680 call BT_cont_to_face_areas(BT_cont, Datu, Datv, G, US, MS, halo=0)
386914 elseif (CS%Nonlinear_continuity .and. present(eta)) then
38704 call find_face_areas(Datu, Datv, G, GV, US, CS, MS, 0, eta=eta)
3871 else
387214 call find_face_areas(Datu, Datv, G, GV, US, CS, MS, 0, add_max=add_SSH)
3873 endif
3874
387514 det_de = 0.0
387614 if (CS%calculate_SAL) call scalar_SAL_sensitivity(CS%SAL_CSp, det_de)
387714 if (CS%tidal_sal_bug) then
38780 dgeo_de = 1.0 + max(0.0, det_de + CS%G_extra)
3879 else
388014 dgeo_de = 1.0 + max(0.0, CS%G_extra - det_de)
3881 endif
388214 if (present(pbce)) then
388313 do concurrent (j=js:je)
3884780 do concurrent (i=is:ie)
3885259200 gtot_E(i,j) = 0.0 ; gtot_W(i,j) = 0.0
3886259920 gtot_N(i,j) = 0.0 ; gtot_S(i,j) = 0.0
3887 enddo
388860073 do k=1,nz
3889780 do concurrent (i=is:ie)
38907020000 gtot_E(i,j) = gtot_E(i,j) + pbce(i,j,k) * CS%frhatu(I,j,k)
38917020000 gtot_W(i,j) = gtot_W(i,j) + pbce(i,j,k) * CS%frhatu(I-1,j,k)
38927020000 gtot_N(i,j) = gtot_N(i,j) + pbce(i,j,k) * CS%frhatv(i,J,k)
38937078500 gtot_S(i,j) = gtot_S(i,j) + pbce(i,j,k) * CS%frhatv(i,J-1,k)
3894 enddo
3895 enddo
3896 enddo
3897 else
38981 do concurrent (j=js:je, i=is:ie)
389964800 gtot_E(i,j) = gtot_est ; gtot_W(i,j) = gtot_est
390065161 gtot_N(i,j) = gtot_est ; gtot_S(i,j) = gtot_est
3901 enddo
3902 endif
3903
390414 min_max_dt2 = 1.0e38*US%s_to_T**2 ! A huge value for the permissible timestep squared.
390514 do concurrent (j=js:je, i=is:ie) DO_LOCALITY(reduce(min:min_max_dt2))
3906 ! This is pretty accurate for gravity waves, but it is a conservative
3907 ! estimate since it ignores the stabilizing effect of the bottom drag.
3908 Idt_max2 = 0.5 * (1.0 + 2.0*CS%bebt) * (G%IareaT(i,j) * &
3909 (((gtot_E(i,j)*Datu(I,j)*G%IdxCu(I,j)) + (gtot_W(i,j)*Datu(I-1,j)*G%IdxCu(I-1,j))) + &
3910 ((gtot_N(i,j)*Datv(i,J)*G%IdyCv(i,J)) + (gtot_S(i,j)*Datv(i,J-1)*G%IdyCv(i,J-1)))) + &
3911 ((G%Coriolis2Bu(I,J) + G%Coriolis2Bu(I-1,J-1)) + &
3912324000 (G%Coriolis2Bu(I-1,J) + G%Coriolis2Bu(I,J-1))) * CS%BT_Coriolis_scale**2 )
3913325805 if (Idt_max2 * min_max_dt2 > 1.0) min_max_dt2 = 1.0 / Idt_max2
3914 enddo
3915 !$omp target exit data map(release: gtot_E, gtot_W, gtot_N, gtot_S, Datu, Datv)
391614 dtbt_max = sqrt(min_max_dt2 / dgeo_de)
391714 if (id_clock_sync > 0) call cpu_clock_begin(id_clock_sync)
391814 call min_across_PEs(dtbt_max)
391914 if (id_clock_sync > 0) call cpu_clock_end(id_clock_sync)
3920
392114 CS%dtbt = CS%dtbt_fraction * dtbt_max
392214 CS%dtbt_max = dtbt_max
3923
392414 if (is_root_PE() .and. present(Time)) then
392513 call get_date(Time, yr, mon, day, hr, minute, sec)
3926 write(mesg, '("DTBT reset by set_dtbt at ",i4.4,"-",i2.2,"-",i2.2," ",i2.2,":",i2.2,":",i2.2, &
3927 & ", dtbt = ",ES12.6," s, dtbt_max = ",ES12.6," s")') &
392813 yr, mon, day, hr, minute, sec, (US%T_to_s*CS%dtbt), (US%T_to_s*dtbt_max)
392913 call MOM_mesg(mesg, 3)
3930 endif
3931
393214 if (CS%debug) then
39330 call chksum0(CS%dtbt, "End set_dtbt dtbt", unscale=US%T_to_s)
39340 call chksum0(CS%dtbt_max, "End set_dtbt dtbt_max", unscale=US%T_to_s)
3935 endif
393627end subroutine set_dtbt
3937
3938! The following 5 subroutines apply the open boundary conditions.
3939
3940!> This subroutine applies the open boundary conditions on barotropic zonal
3941!! velocities and mass transports, as developed by Mehmet Ilicak.
39420subroutine apply_u_velocity_OBCs(ubt, uhbt, ubt_trans, eta, SpV_avg, ubt_old, BT_OBC, G, MS, &
3943 GV, US, CS, halo, dtbt, bebt, use_BT_cont, integral_BT_cont, dt_elapsed, &
39440 Datu, BTCL_u, uhbt0, ubt_int, ubt_int_prev, uhbt_int, uhbt_int_prev)
3945 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
3946 type(memory_size_type), intent(in) :: MS !< A type that describes the memory sizes of
3947 !! the argument arrays.
3948 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(inout) :: ubt !< the zonal barotropic velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
3949 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(inout) :: uhbt !< the zonal barotropic transport
3950 !! [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1].
3951 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(inout) :: ubt_trans !< The zonal barotropic velocity used in
3952 !! transport [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
3953 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: eta !< The barotropic free surface height anomaly or
3954 !! column mass anomaly [H ~> m or kg m-2].
3955 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: SpV_avg !< The column average specific volume [R-1 ~> m3 kg-1]
3956 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: ubt_old !< The starting value of ubt in a barotropic
3957 !! step [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
3958 type(BT_OBC_type), intent(in) :: BT_OBC !< A structure with the private barotropic arrays
3959 !! related to the open boundary conditions,
3960 !! set by set_up_BT_OBC.
3961 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
3962 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
3963 type(barotropic_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
3964 integer, intent(in) :: halo !< The extra halo size to use here.
3965 real, intent(in) :: dtbt !< The time step [T ~> s].
3966 real, intent(in) :: bebt !< The fractional weighting of the future velocity
3967 !! in determining the transport [nondim]
3968 logical, intent(in) :: use_BT_cont !< If true, use the BT_cont_types to calculate
3969 !! transports.
3970 logical, intent(in) :: integral_BT_cont !< If true, update the barotropic continuity
3971 !! equation directly from the initial condition
3972 !! using the time-integrated barotropic velocity.
3973 real, intent(in) :: dt_elapsed !< The amount of time in the barotropic stepping
3974 !! that will have elapsed [T ~> s].
3975 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: Datu !< A fixed estimate of the face areas at u points
3976 !! [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
3977 type(local_BT_cont_u_type), dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: BTCL_u !< Structure of information used
3978 !! for a dynamic estimate of the face areas at
3979 !! u-points.
3980 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: uhbt0 !< A correction to the zonal transport so that
3981 !! the barotropic functions agree with the sum
3982 !! of the layer transports
3983 !! [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1].
3984 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(inout) :: ubt_int !< The time-integrated zonal barotropic
3985 !! velocity after this update [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
3986 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: ubt_int_prev !< The time-integrated zonal barotropic
3987 !! velocity before this update [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
3988 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(inout) :: uhbt_int !< The time-integrated zonal barotropic transport
3989 !! after this update [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1]
3990 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: uhbt_int_prev !< The time-integrated zonal barotropic
3991 !! transport before this update
3992 !! [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1]
3993
3994 ! Local variables
3995 real :: vel_prev ! The previous velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
3996 real :: cfl ! The CFL number at the point in question [nondim]
3997 real :: u_inlet ! The zonal inflow velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
3998 real :: uhbt_int_new ! The updated time-integrated zonal transport [H L2 ~> m3]
3999 real :: ssh_in ! The inflow sea surface height [Z ~> m]
4000 real :: ssh_1 ! The sea surface height in the interior cell adjacent to the an OBC face [Z ~> m]
4001 real :: ssh_2 ! The sea surface height in the next cell inward from the OBC face [Z ~> m]
4002 real :: Idtbt ! The inverse of the barotropic time step [T-1 ~> s-1]
4003 integer :: i, j, Is_u, Ie_u, js, je
4004
40050 if (.not.BT_OBC%u_OBCs_on_PE) return
4006
40070 Idtbt = 1.0 / dtbt
4008
4009 ! Work on Eastern OBC points
40100 Is_u = max((G%isc-1)-halo, BT_OBC%Is_u_E_obc) ; Ie_u = min(G%iec+halo, BT_OBC%Ie_u_E_obc)
40110 js = max(G%jsc-halo, BT_OBC%js_u_E_obc) ; je = min(G%jec+halo, BT_OBC%je_u_E_obc)
40120 do j=js,je ; do I=Is_u,Ie_u ; if (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) > 0) then
40130 if (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) == SPECIFIED_OBC) then ! Eastern specified OBC
40140 uhbt(I,j) = BT_OBC%uhbt(I,j)
40150 ubt(I,j) = BT_OBC%ubt_outer(I,j)
40160 ubt_trans(I,j) = ubt(I,j)
40170 if (integral_BT_cont) then
40180 uhbt_int(I,j) = uhbt_int_prev(I,j) + dtbt * uhbt(I,j)
40190 ubt_int(I,j) = ubt_int_prev(I,j) + dtbt * ubt_trans(I,j)
4020 endif
40210 elseif (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) == FLATHER_OBC) then ! Eastern Flather OBC
40220 cfl = dtbt * BT_OBC%Cg_u(I,j) * G%IdxCu(I,j) ! CFL
40230 u_inlet = cfl*ubt_old(I-1,j) + (1.0-cfl)*ubt_old(I,j) ! Valid for cfl<1
40240 if (I <= MS%isdw) then
4025 ! Do not apply an Eastern Flather OBC at the western halo points on a PE, as doing so would
4026 ! create a segmentation fault and this velocity will not propagate through to the next iteration.
40270 ssh_in = BT_OBC%SSH_outer_u(I,j)
40280 elseif (GV%Boussinesq) then
40290 ssh_in = GV%H_to_Z*(eta(i,j) + (0.5-cfl)*(eta(i,j)-eta(i-1,j))) ! internal
4030 else
40310 ssh_1 = GV%H_to_RZ * eta(i,j) * SpV_avg(i,j) - (CS%bathyT(i,j) + G%Z_ref)
40320 ssh_2 = GV%H_to_RZ * eta(i-1,j) * SpV_avg(i-1,j) - (CS%bathyT(i-1,j) + G%Z_ref)
40330 ssh_in = ssh_1 + (0.5-cfl)*(ssh_1-ssh_2) ! internal
4034 endif
40350 if (BT_OBC%dZ_u(I,j) > 0.0) then
40360 vel_prev = ubt(I,j)
4037 ubt(I,j) = 0.5*((u_inlet + BT_OBC%ubt_outer(I,j)) + &
40380 (BT_OBC%Cg_u(I,j)/BT_OBC%dZ_u(I,j)) * (ssh_in-BT_OBC%SSH_outer_u(I,j)))
40390 ubt_trans(I,j) = (1.0-bebt)*vel_prev + bebt*ubt(I,j)
4040 else ! This point is now dry.
40410 ubt(I,j) = 0.0
40420 ubt_trans(I,j) = 0.0
4043 endif
40440 elseif (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) == GRADIENT_OBC) then ! Eastern gradient OBC
40450 ubt(I,j) = ubt(I-1,j)
40460 ubt_trans(I,j) = ubt(I,j)
4047 endif
4048
4049 ! Reset transports and related time-inetegrated velocities with non-specified OBCs
40500 if (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) > SPECIFIED_OBC) then ! Eastern Flather or gradient OBC
40510 if (integral_BT_cont) then
40520 ubt_int(I,j) = ubt_int_prev(I,j) + dtbt * ubt_trans(I,j)
40530 uhbt_int_new = find_uhbt(ubt_int(I,j), BTCL_u(I,j)) + dt_elapsed*uhbt0(I,j)
40540 uhbt(I,j) = (uhbt_int_new - uhbt_int_prev(I,j)) * Idtbt
40550 uhbt_int(I,j) = uhbt_int_prev(I,j) + dtbt * uhbt(I,j)
4056 ! The line above is equivalent to: uhbt_int(I,j) = uhbt_int_new
40570 elseif (use_BT_cont) then
40580 uhbt(I,j) = find_uhbt(ubt_trans(I,j), BTCL_u(I,j)) + uhbt0(I,j)
4059 else
40600 uhbt(I,j) = Datu(I,j)*ubt_trans(I,j) + uhbt0(I,j)
4061 endif
4062 endif
4063
4064 endif ; enddo ; enddo
4065
4066 ! Work on Western OBC points
40670 Is_u = max((G%isc-1)-halo, BT_OBC%Is_u_W_obc) ; Ie_u = min(G%iec+halo, BT_OBC%Ie_u_W_obc)
40680 js = max(G%jsc-halo, BT_OBC%js_u_W_obc) ; je = min(G%jec+halo, BT_OBC%je_u_W_obc)
40690 do j=js,je ; do I=Is_u,Ie_u ; if (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) < 0) then
40700 if (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) == -SPECIFIED_OBC) then ! Western specified OBC
40710 uhbt(I,j) = BT_OBC%uhbt(I,j)
40720 ubt(I,j) = BT_OBC%ubt_outer(I,j)
40730 ubt_trans(I,j) = ubt(I,j)
40740 if (integral_BT_cont) then
40750 uhbt_int(I,j) = uhbt_int_prev(I,j) + dtbt * uhbt(I,j)
40760 ubt_int(I,j) = ubt_int_prev(I,j) + dtbt * ubt_trans(I,j)
4077 endif
40780 elseif (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) == -FLATHER_OBC) then ! Western Flather OBC
40790 cfl = dtbt * BT_OBC%Cg_u(I,j) * G%IdxCu(I,j) ! CFL
40800 u_inlet = cfl*ubt_old(I+1,j) + (1.0-cfl)*ubt_old(I,j) ! Valid for cfl<1
40810 if (I >= MS%iedw-1) then
4082 ! Do not apply a Western Flather OBC at the eastern halo points on a PE, as doing so would
4083 ! create a segmentation fault and this velocity will not propagate through to the next iteration.
40840 ssh_in = BT_OBC%SSH_outer_u(I,j)
40850 elseif (GV%Boussinesq) then
40860 ssh_in = GV%H_to_Z*(eta(i+1,j) + (0.5-cfl)*(eta(i+1,j)-eta(i+2,j))) ! internal
4087 else
40880 ssh_1 = GV%H_to_RZ * eta(i+1,j) * SpV_avg(i+1,j) - (CS%bathyT(i+1,j) + G%Z_ref)
40890 ssh_2 = GV%H_to_RZ * eta(i+2,j) * SpV_avg(i+2,j) - (CS%bathyT(i+2,j) + G%Z_ref)
40900 ssh_in = ssh_1 + (0.5-cfl)*(ssh_1-ssh_2) ! internal
4091 endif
4092
40930 if (BT_OBC%dZ_u(I,j) > 0.0) then
40940 vel_prev = ubt(I,j)
4095 ubt(I,j) = 0.5*((u_inlet + BT_OBC%ubt_outer(I,j)) + &
40960 (BT_OBC%Cg_u(I,j)/BT_OBC%dZ_u(I,j)) * (BT_OBC%SSH_outer_u(I,j)-ssh_in))
40970 ubt_trans(I,j) = (1.0-bebt)*vel_prev + bebt*ubt(I,j)
4098 else ! This point is now dry.
40990 ubt(I,j) = 0.0
41000 ubt_trans(I,j) = 0.0
4101 endif
41020 elseif (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) == -GRADIENT_OBC) then ! Western gradient OBC
41030 ubt(I,j) = ubt(I+1,j)
41040 ubt_trans(I,j) = ubt(I,j)
4105 endif
4106
4107 ! Reset transports and related time-inetegrated velocities with non-specified OBCs
41080 if (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) < -SPECIFIED_OBC) then ! Western Flather or gradient OBC
41090 if (integral_BT_cont) then
41100 ubt_int(I,j) = ubt_int_prev(I,j) + dtbt * ubt_trans(I,j)
41110 uhbt_int_new = find_uhbt(ubt_int(I,j), BTCL_u(I,j)) + dt_elapsed*uhbt0(I,j)
41120 uhbt(I,j) = (uhbt_int_new - uhbt_int_prev(I,j)) * Idtbt
41130 uhbt_int(I,j) = uhbt_int_prev(I,j) + dtbt * uhbt(I,j)
4114 ! The line above is equivalent to: uhbt_int(I,j) = uhbt_int_new
41150 elseif (use_BT_cont) then
41160 uhbt(I,j) = find_uhbt(ubt_trans(I,j), BTCL_u(I,j)) + uhbt0(I,j)
4117 else
41180 uhbt(I,j) = Datu(I,j)*ubt_trans(I,j) + uhbt0(I,j)
4119 endif
4120 endif
4121
4122 endif ; enddo ; enddo
4123
4124end subroutine apply_u_velocity_OBCs
4125
4126!> This subroutine applies the open boundary conditions on barotropic meridional
4127!! velocities and mass transports, as developed by Mehmet Ilicak.
41280subroutine apply_v_velocity_OBCs(vbt, vhbt, vbt_trans, eta, SpV_avg, vbt_old, BT_OBC, &
4129 G, MS, GV, US, CS, halo, dtbt, bebt, use_BT_cont, integral_BT_cont, dt_elapsed, &
41300 Datv, BTCL_v, vhbt0, vbt_int, vbt_int_prev, vhbt_int, vhbt_int_prev)
4131 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
4132 type(memory_size_type), intent(in) :: MS !< A type that describes the memory sizes of
4133 !! the argument arrays.
4134 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(inout) :: vbt !< The meridional barotropic velocity
4135 !! [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
4136 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(inout) :: vhbt !< the meridional barotropic transport
4137 !! [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1].
4138 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(inout) :: vbt_trans !< the meridional BT velocity used in
4139 !! transports [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
4140 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: eta !< The barotropic free surface height anomaly or
4141 !! column mass anomaly [H ~> m or kg m-2].
4142 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: SpV_avg !< The column average specific volume [R-1 ~> m3 kg-1]
4143 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(in) :: vbt_old !< The starting value of vbt in a barotropic
4144 !! step [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
4145 type(BT_OBC_type), intent(in) :: BT_OBC !< A structure with the private barotropic arrays
4146 !! related to the open boundary conditions,
4147 !! set by set_up_BT_OBC.
4148 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
4149 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
4150 type(barotropic_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
4151 integer, intent(in) :: halo !< The extra halo size to use here.
4152 real, intent(in) :: dtbt !< The time step [T ~> s].
4153 real, intent(in) :: bebt !< The fractional weighting of the future velocity
4154 !! in determining the transport [nondim]
4155 logical, intent(in) :: use_BT_cont !< If true, use the BT_cont_types to calculate
4156 !! transports.
4157 logical, intent(in) :: integral_BT_cont !< If true, update the barotropic continuity
4158 !! equation directly from the initial condition
4159 !! using the time-integrated barotropic velocity.
4160 real, intent(in) :: dt_elapsed !< The amount of time in the barotropic stepping
4161 !! that will have elapsed [T ~> s].
4162 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(in) :: Datv !< A fixed estimate of the face areas at v points
4163 !! [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
4164 type(local_BT_cont_v_type), dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(in) :: BTCL_v !< Structure of information used
4165 !! for a dynamic estimate of the face areas at
4166 !! v-points.
4167 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(in) :: vhbt0 !< A correction to the meridional transport so that
4168 !! the barotropic functions agree with the sum
4169 !! of the layer transports
4170 !! [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1].
4171 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(inout) :: vbt_int !< The time-integrated meridional barotropic
4172 !! velocity after this update [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
4173 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(in) :: vbt_int_prev !< The time-integrated meridional barotropic
4174 !! velocity before this update [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
4175 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(inout) :: vhbt_int !< The time-integrated meridional barotropic
4176 !! transport after this update
4177 !! [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1]
4178 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(in) :: vhbt_int_prev !< The time-integrated meridional barotropic
4179 !! transport before this update
4180 !! [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1]
4181
4182 ! Local variables
4183 real :: vel_prev ! The previous velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
4184 real :: cfl ! The CFL number at the point in question [nondim]
4185 real :: v_inlet ! The meridional inflow velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
4186 real :: vhbt_int_new ! The updated time-integrated meridional transport [H L2 ~> m3]
4187 real :: ssh_in ! The inflow sea surface height [Z ~> m]
4188 real :: ssh_1 ! The sea surface height in the interior cell adjacent to the an OBC face [Z ~> m]
4189 real :: ssh_2 ! The sea surface height in the next cell inward from the OBC face [Z ~> m]
4190 real :: Idtbt ! The inverse of the barotropic time step [T-1 ~> s-1]
4191 integer :: i, j, is, ie, Js_v, Je_v
4192
41930 if (.not.BT_OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE) return
4194
41950 Idtbt = 1.0 / dtbt
4196
4197 ! This routine uses separate blocks of code and loops for Northern and southern open boundary
4198 ! condition points, despite this leading to some code duplication, because the OBCs almost always
4199 ! occur at the edge of the domain, and in parallel appliations, most PEs will only have one or
4200 ! the other.
4201
4202
4203 ! Work on Northern OBC points
42040 is = max(G%isc-halo, BT_OBC%is_v_N_obc) ; ie = min(G%iec+halo, BT_OBC%ie_v_N_obc)
42050 Js_v = max((G%jsc-1)-halo, BT_OBC%Js_v_N_obc) ; Je_v = min(G%jec+halo, BT_OBC%Je_v_N_obc)
42060 do J=Js_v,Je_v ; do i=is,ie ; if (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) > 0) then
42070 if (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) == SPECIFIED_OBC) then ! Northern specified OBC
42080 vhbt(i,J) = BT_OBC%vhbt(i,J)
42090 vbt(i,J) = BT_OBC%vbt_outer(i,J)
42100 vbt_trans(i,J) = vbt(i,J)
42110 if (integral_BT_cont) then
42120 vbt_int(i,J) = vbt_int_prev(i,J) + dtbt * vbt(i,J)
42130 vhbt_int(i,J) = vhbt_int_prev(i,J) + dtbt * vhbt(i,J)
4214 endif
42150 elseif (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) == FLATHER_OBC) then ! Northern Flather OBC
42160 cfl = dtbt * BT_OBC%Cg_v(i,J) * G%IdyCv(i,J) ! CFL
42170 v_inlet = cfl*vbt_old(i,J-1) + (1.0-cfl)*vbt_old(i,J) ! Valid for cfl<1
42180 if (J <= MS%jsdw) then
4219 ! Do not apply a Northern Flather OBC at the southern halo points on a PE, as doing so would
4220 ! create a segmentation fault and this velocity will not propagate through to the next iteration.
42210 ssh_in = BT_OBC%SSH_outer_v(i,J)
42220 elseif (GV%Boussinesq) then
42230 ssh_in = GV%H_to_Z*(eta(i,j) + (0.5-cfl)*(eta(i,j)-eta(i,j-1))) ! internal
4224 else
42250 ssh_1 = GV%H_to_RZ * eta(i,j) * SpV_avg(i,j) - (CS%bathyT(i,j) + G%Z_ref)
42260 ssh_2 = GV%H_to_RZ * eta(i,j-1) * SpV_avg(i,j-1) - (CS%bathyT(i,j-1) + G%Z_ref)
42270 ssh_in = ssh_1 + (0.5-cfl)*(ssh_1-ssh_2) ! internal
4228 endif
4229
42300 if (BT_OBC%dZ_v(i,J) > 0.0) then
42310 vel_prev = vbt(i,J)
4232 vbt(i,J) = 0.5*((v_inlet + BT_OBC%vbt_outer(i,J)) + &
42330 (BT_OBC%Cg_v(i,J)/BT_OBC%dZ_v(i,J)) * (ssh_in-BT_OBC%SSH_outer_v(i,J)))
42340 vbt_trans(i,J) = (1.0-bebt)*vel_prev + bebt*vbt(i,J)
4235 else ! This point is now dry
42360 vbt(i,J) = 0.0
42370 vbt_trans(i,J) = 0.0
4238 endif
42390 elseif (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) == GRADIENT_OBC) then ! Northern gradient OBC
42400 vbt(i,J) = vbt(i,J-1)
42410 vbt_trans(i,J) = vbt(i,J)
4242 endif
4243
4244 ! Reset transports and related time-inetegrated velocities with non-specified OBCs
42450 if (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) > SPECIFIED_OBC) then ! Northern Flather or gradient OBC
42460 if (integral_BT_cont) then
42470 vbt_int(i,J) = vbt_int_prev(i,J) + dtbt * vbt_trans(i,J)
42480 vhbt_int_new = find_vhbt(vbt_int(i,J), BTCL_v(i,J)) + dt_elapsed*vhbt0(i,J)
42490 vhbt(i,J) = (vhbt_int_new - vhbt_int_prev(i,J)) * Idtbt
42500 vhbt_int(i,J) = vhbt_int_prev(i,J) + dtbt * vhbt(i,J)
4251 ! The line above is equivalent to: vhbt_int(i,J) = vhbt_int_new
42520 elseif (use_BT_cont) then
42530 vhbt(i,J) = find_vhbt(vbt_trans(i,J), BTCL_v(i,J)) + vhbt0(i,J)
4254 else
42550 vhbt(i,J) = vbt_trans(i,J)*Datv(i,J) + vhbt0(i,J)
4256 endif
4257 endif
4258
4259 endif ; enddo ; enddo
4260
4261 ! Work on Southern OBC points
42620 is = max(G%isc-halo, BT_OBC%is_v_S_obc) ; ie = min(G%iec+halo, BT_OBC%ie_v_S_obc)
42630 Js_v = max((G%jsc-1)-halo, BT_OBC%Js_v_S_obc) ; Je_v = min(G%jec+halo, BT_OBC%Je_v_S_obc)
42640 do J=Js_v,Je_v ; do i=is,ie ; if (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) < 0) then
42650 if (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) == -SPECIFIED_OBC) then ! Southern specified OBC
42660 vhbt(i,J) = BT_OBC%vhbt(i,J)
42670 vbt(i,J) = BT_OBC%vbt_outer(i,J)
42680 vbt_trans(i,J) = vbt(i,J)
42690 if (integral_BT_cont) then
42700 vbt_int(i,J) = vbt_int_prev(i,J) + dtbt * vbt(i,J)
42710 vhbt_int(i,J) = vhbt_int_prev(i,J) + dtbt * vhbt(i,J)
4272 endif
42730 elseif (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) == -FLATHER_OBC) then ! Southern Flather OBC
42740 cfl = dtbt * BT_OBC%Cg_v(i,J) * G%IdyCv(i,J) ! CFL
42750 v_inlet = cfl*vbt_old(i,J+1) + (1.0-cfl)*vbt_old(i,J) ! Valid for cfl <1
42760 if (J >= MS%jedw-1) then
4277 ! Do not apply a Southern Flather OBC at the northern halo points on a PE, as doing so would
4278 ! create a segmentation fault and this velocity will not propagate through to the next iteration.
42790 ssh_in = BT_OBC%SSH_outer_v(i,J)
42800 elseif (GV%Boussinesq) then
42810 ssh_in = GV%H_to_Z*(eta(i,j+1) + (0.5-cfl)*(eta(i,j+1)-eta(i,j+2))) ! internal
4282 else
42830 ssh_1 = GV%H_to_RZ * eta(i,j+1) * SpV_avg(i,j+1) - (CS%bathyT(i,j+1) + G%Z_ref)
42840 ssh_2 = GV%H_to_RZ * eta(i,j+2) * SpV_avg(i,j+2) - (CS%bathyT(i,j+2) + G%Z_ref)
42850 ssh_in = ssh_1 + (0.5-cfl)*(ssh_1-ssh_2) ! internal
4286 endif
4287
42880 if (BT_OBC%dZ_v(i,J) > 0.0) then
42890 vel_prev = vbt(i,J)
4290 vbt(i,J) = 0.5*((v_inlet + BT_OBC%vbt_outer(i,J)) + &
42910 (BT_OBC%Cg_v(i,J)/BT_OBC%dZ_v(i,J)) * (BT_OBC%SSH_outer_v(i,J)-ssh_in))
42920 vbt_trans(i,J) = (1.0-bebt)*vel_prev + bebt*vbt(i,J)
4293 else ! This point is now dry
42940 vbt(i,J) = 0.0
42950 vbt_trans(i,J) = 0.0
4296 endif
42970 elseif (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) == -GRADIENT_OBC) then ! Southern gradient OBC
42980 vbt(i,J) = vbt(i,J+1)
42990 vbt_trans(i,J) = vbt(i,J)
4300 endif
4301
4302 ! Reset transports and related time-inetegrated velocities with non-specified OBCs
43030 if (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) < -SPECIFIED_OBC) then ! Southern Flather or gradient OBC
43040 if (integral_BT_cont) then
43050 vbt_int(i,J) = vbt_int_prev(i,J) + dtbt * vbt_trans(i,J)
43060 vhbt_int_new = find_vhbt(vbt_int(i,J), BTCL_v(i,J)) + dt_elapsed*vhbt0(i,J)
43070 vhbt(i,J) = (vhbt_int_new - vhbt_int_prev(i,J)) * Idtbt
43080 vhbt_int(i,J) = vhbt_int_prev(i,J) + dtbt * vhbt(i,J)
4309 ! The line above is equivalent to: vhbt_int(i,J) = vhbt_int_new
43100 elseif (use_BT_cont) then
43110 vhbt(i,J) = find_vhbt(vbt_trans(i,J), BTCL_v(i,J)) + vhbt0(i,J)
4312 else
43130 vhbt(i,J) = vbt_trans(i,J)*Datv(i,J) + vhbt0(i,J)
4314 endif
4315 endif
4316
4317 endif ; enddo ; enddo
4318
4319end subroutine apply_v_velocity_OBCs
4320
4321!> This subroutine sets up the time-invariant control information about the open boundary
4322!! conditions on the full wide halo domain used by the barotropic solver.
43230subroutine initialize_BT_OBC(OBC, BT_OBC, G, CS)
4324 type(ocean_OBC_type), target, intent(inout) :: OBC !< An associated pointer to an OBC type.
4325 type(BT_OBC_type), intent(inout) :: BT_OBC !< A structure with the private barotropic arrays
4326 !! related to the open boundary conditions,
4327 !! set by set_up_BT_OBC.
4328 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
4329 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
4330
4331 ! Local variables
4332 real, dimension(SZIBW_(CS),SZJW_(CS)) :: &
43330 u_OBC ! A set of integers encoding the nature of the u-point open boundary conditions,
4334 ! converted to real numbers to work with the MOM6 halo update code [nondim]
4335 real, dimension(SZIW_(CS),SZJBW_(CS)) :: &
43360 v_OBC ! A set of integers encoding the nature of the v-point open boundary conditions,
4337 ! converted to real numbers to work with the MOM6 halo update code [nondim]
4338 integer :: OBC_type ! The integer encoding the type of OBC being used at a point [nondim]
4339 logical :: reversed_OBCs ! True of there any OBCs in the opposite halo on this PE, e.g. points
4340 ! with a southern OBC in a northern halo.
4341 logical :: any_reversed_OBCs
4342 integer :: i, j, isdw, iedw, jsdw, jedw
4343 integer :: l_seg, Flather_OBC_in_halo
4344
43450 isdw = CS%isdw ; iedw = CS%iedw ; jsdw = CS%jsdw ; jedw = CS%jedw
4346
43470 u_OBC(:,:) = 0.0
43480 v_OBC(:,:) = 0.0
4349
43500 do j=G%jsc,G%jec ; do I=G%isc-1,G%iec
4351
43520 OBC_type = 0
43530 if (OBC%segnum_u(I,j) /= 0) then
43540 l_seg = abs(OBC%segnum_u(I,j))
43550 if (OBC%segment(l_seg)%gradient) OBC_type = GRADIENT_OBC
43560 if (OBC%segment(l_seg)%Flather) OBC_type = FLATHER_OBC
43570 if (OBC%segment(l_seg)%specified) OBC_type = SPECIFIED_OBC
43580 u_OBC(I,j) = sign(OBC_type, OBC%segnum_u(I,j))
4359 endif
4360 enddo ; enddo
4361
43620 do J=G%jsc-1,G%jec ; do i=G%isc,G%iec
43630 OBC_type = 0
43640 if (OBC%segnum_v(i,J) /= 0) then
43650 l_seg = abs(OBC%segnum_v(i,J))
43660 if (OBC%segment(l_seg)%gradient) OBC_type = GRADIENT_OBC
43670 if (OBC%segment(l_seg)%Flather) OBC_type = FLATHER_OBC
43680 if (OBC%segment(l_seg)%specified) OBC_type = SPECIFIED_OBC
43690 v_OBC(i,J) = sign(OBC_type, OBC%segnum_v(i,J))
4370 endif
4371 enddo ; enddo
4372
43730 call pass_vector(u_OBC, v_OBC, CS%BT_Domain)
4374
43750 allocate(BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(isdw-1:iedw,jsdw:jedw), source=0)
43760 allocate(BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(isdw:iedw,jsdw-1:jedw), source=0)
4377
4378 ! Determine the maximum and minimum index range for various directions of OBC points on this PE
4379 ! by first setting these one point outside of the wrong side of the domain.
43800 BT_OBC%Is_u_W_obc = iedw + 1 ; BT_OBC%Ie_u_W_obc = isdw - 2
43810 BT_OBC%js_u_W_obc = jedw + 1 ; BT_OBC%je_u_W_obc = jsdw - 1
43820 BT_OBC%Is_u_E_obc = iedw + 1 ; BT_OBC%Ie_u_E_obc = isdw - 2
43830 BT_OBC%js_u_E_obc = jedw + 1 ; BT_OBC%je_u_E_obc = jsdw - 1
43840 BT_OBC%is_v_S_obc = iedw + 1 ; BT_OBC%ie_v_S_obc = isdw - 1
43850 BT_OBC%Js_v_S_obc = jedw + 1 ; BT_OBC%Je_v_S_obc = jsdw - 2
43860 BT_OBC%is_v_N_obc = iedw + 1 ; BT_OBC%ie_v_N_obc = isdw - 1
43870 BT_OBC%Js_v_N_obc = jedw + 1 ; BT_OBC%Je_v_N_obc = jsdw - 2
4388
43890 Flather_OBC_in_halo = 0
43900 do j=jsdw,jedw ; do I=isdw-1,iedw
43910 BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) = nint(u_OBC(I,j))
43920 if (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) < 0) then ! This point has OBC_DIRECTION_W.
43930 if ((BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) == -FLATHER_OBC) .and. (I >= iedw-1)) then
4394 ! There is no need to specify the OBC at this point, but the stencil might need to be increased.
43950 Flather_OBC_in_halo = 1
4396 else
43970 BT_OBC%Is_u_W_obc = min(I, BT_OBC%Is_u_W_obc) ; BT_OBC%Ie_u_W_obc = max(I, BT_OBC%Ie_u_W_obc)
43980 BT_OBC%js_u_W_obc = min(j, BT_OBC%js_u_W_obc) ; BT_OBC%je_u_W_obc = max(j, BT_OBC%je_u_W_obc)
4399 endif
4400 endif
44010 if (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) > 0) then ! This point has OBC_DIRECTION_E.
44020 if ((BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) == FLATHER_OBC) .and. (I <= isdw)) then
4403 ! There is no need to specify the OBC at this point, but the stencil might need to be increased.
44040 Flather_OBC_in_halo = 1
4405 else
44060 BT_OBC%Is_u_E_obc = min(I, BT_OBC%Is_u_E_obc) ; BT_OBC%Ie_u_E_obc = max(I, BT_OBC%Ie_u_E_obc)
44070 BT_OBC%js_u_E_obc = min(j, BT_OBC%js_u_E_obc) ; BT_OBC%je_u_E_obc = max(j, BT_OBC%je_u_E_obc)
4408 endif
4409 endif
4410 enddo ; enddo
4411
44120 do J=jsdw-1,jedw ; do i=isdw,iedw
44130 BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) = nint(v_OBC(i,J))
44140 if (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) < 0) then ! This point has OBC_DIRECTION_S.
44150 if ((BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) == -FLATHER_OBC) .and. (J >= jedw-1)) then
4416 ! There is no need to specify the OBC at this point, but the stencil might need to be increased.
44170 Flather_OBC_in_halo = 1
4418 else
44190 BT_OBC%is_v_S_obc = min(i, BT_OBC%is_v_S_obc) ; BT_OBC%ie_v_S_obc = max(i, BT_OBC%ie_v_S_obc)
44200 BT_OBC%Js_v_S_obc = min(J, BT_OBC%Js_v_S_obc) ; BT_OBC%Je_v_S_obc = max(J, BT_OBC%Je_v_S_obc)
4421 endif
4422 endif
44230 if (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) > 0) then ! This point has OBC_DIRECTION_N.
44240 if ((BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) == FLATHER_OBC) .and. (J <= jsdw)) then
4425 ! There is no need to specify the OBC at this point, but the stencil might need to be increased.
44260 Flather_OBC_in_halo = 1
4427 else
44280 BT_OBC%is_v_N_obc = min(i, BT_OBC%is_v_N_obc) ; BT_OBC%ie_v_N_obc = max(i, BT_OBC%ie_v_N_obc)
44290 BT_OBC%Js_v_N_obc = min(J, BT_OBC%Js_v_N_obc) ; BT_OBC%Je_v_N_obc = max(J, BT_OBC%Je_v_N_obc)
4430 endif
4431 endif
4432 enddo ; enddo
4433
44340 BT_OBC%u_OBCs_on_PE = ((BT_OBC%Is_u_E_obc <= iedw) .or. (BT_OBC%Is_u_W_obc <= iedw))
44350 BT_OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE = ((BT_OBC%is_v_N_obc <= iedw) .or. (BT_OBC%is_v_S_obc <= iedw))
4436
4437
4438 ! Determine whether there are any OBCs in the opposite halo on any processors in the domain, e.g.,
4439 ! points with OBC_DIRECTION_S in a northern halo.
4440 reversed_OBCs = (BT_OBC%u_OBCs_on_PE .and. ((BT_OBC%Is_u_E_obc <= G%isc-1) .or. (BT_OBC%Ie_u_W_obc >= G%iec))) .or. &
44410 (BT_OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE .and. ((BT_OBC%Js_v_N_obc <= G%jsc-1) .or. (BT_OBC%Je_v_S_obc >= G%jec)))
44420 any_reversed_OBCs = any_across_PEs(reversed_OBCs)
44430 if (any_reversed_OBCs) call MOM_mesg("OBCs in an opposite halo require the use of a wider stencil.", 5)
44440 if (any_reversed_OBCs) CS%min_stencil = max(CS%min_stencil, 2)
4445
4446 ! Allocate time-varying arrays that will be used for open boundary conditions.
4447
4448 ! This pair is used with either Flather or specified OBCs.
44490 allocate(BT_OBC%ubt_outer(isdw-1:iedw,jsdw:jedw), source=0.0)
44500 allocate(BT_OBC%vbt_outer(isdw:iedw,jsdw-1:jedw), source=0.0)
44510 call create_group_pass(BT_OBC%pass_uv, BT_OBC%ubt_outer, BT_OBC%vbt_outer, CS%BT_Domain)
4452
4453 ! This pair is only used with specified OBCs.
44540 allocate(BT_OBC%uhbt(isdw-1:iedw,jsdw:jedw), source=0.0)
44550 allocate(BT_OBC%vhbt(isdw:iedw,jsdw-1:jedw), source=0.0)
44560 call create_group_pass(BT_OBC%pass_uv, BT_OBC%uhbt, BT_OBC%vhbt, CS%BT_Domain)
4457
44580 if (OBC%Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. OBC%Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally) then
4459 ! These 3 pairs are only used with Flather OBCs.
44600 allocate(BT_OBC%Cg_u(isdw-1:iedw,jsdw:jedw), source=0.0)
44610 allocate(BT_OBC%dZ_u(isdw-1:iedw,jsdw:jedw), source=0.0)
44620 allocate(BT_OBC%SSH_outer_u(isdw-1:iedw,jsdw:jedw), source=0.0)
4463
44640 allocate(BT_OBC%Cg_v(isdw:iedw,jsdw-1:jedw), source=0.0)
44650 allocate(BT_OBC%dZ_v(isdw:iedw,jsdw-1:jedw), source=0.0)
44660 allocate(BT_OBC%SSH_outer_v(isdw:iedw,jsdw-1:jedw), source=0.0)
4467
44680 call create_group_pass(BT_OBC%scalar_pass, BT_OBC%SSH_outer_u, BT_OBC%SSH_outer_v, CS%BT_Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
44690 call create_group_pass(BT_OBC%scalar_pass, BT_OBC%dZ_u, BT_OBC%dZ_v, CS%BT_Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
44700 call create_group_pass(BT_OBC%scalar_pass, BT_OBC%Cg_u, BT_OBC%Cg_v, CS%BT_Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
4471 endif
4472
44730end subroutine initialize_BT_OBC
4474
4475!> This subroutine sets up the time-varying fields in the private structure used to apply the open
4476!! boundary conditions, as developed by Mehmet Ilicak.
44770subroutine set_up_BT_OBC(OBC, eta, SpV_avg, BT_OBC, BT_Domain, G, GV, US, CS, MS, halo, use_BT_cont, &
44780 integral_BT_cont, dt_baroclinic, Datu, Datv, BTCL_u, BTCL_v, dgeo_de)
4479 type(ocean_OBC_type), target, intent(inout) :: OBC !< An associated pointer to an OBC type.
4480 type(memory_size_type), intent(in) :: MS !< A type that describes the memory sizes of the
4481 !! argument arrays.
4482 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: eta !< The barotropic free surface height anomaly or
4483 !! column mass anomaly [H ~> m or kg m-2].
4484 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: SpV_avg !< The column average specific volume [R-1 ~> m3 kg-1]
4485 type(BT_OBC_type), intent(inout) :: BT_OBC !< A structure with the private barotropic arrays
4486 !! related to the open boundary conditions,
4487 !! set by set_up_BT_OBC.
4488 type(MOM_domain_type), intent(inout) :: BT_Domain !< MOM_domain_type associated with wide arrays
4489 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
4490 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
4491 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
4492 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
4493 integer, intent(in) :: halo !< The extra halo size to use here.
4494 logical, intent(in) :: use_BT_cont !< If true, use the BT_cont_types to calculate
4495 !! transports.
4496 logical, intent(in) :: integral_BT_cont !< If true, update the barotropic continuity
4497 !! equation directly from the initial condition
4498 !! using the time-integrated barotropic velocity.
4499 real, intent(in) :: dt_baroclinic !< The baroclinic timestep for this cycle of
4500 !! updates to the barotropic solver [T ~> s]
4501 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: Datu !< A fixed estimate of the face areas at u points
4502 !! [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
4503 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(in) :: Datv !< A fixed estimate of the face areas at v points
4504 !! [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
4505 type(local_BT_cont_u_type), dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), intent(in) :: BTCL_u !< Structure of information used
4506 !! for a dynamic estimate of the face areas at
4507 !! u-points.
4508 type(local_BT_cont_v_type), dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), intent(in) :: BTCL_v !< Structure of information used
4509 !! for a dynamic estimate of the face areas at
4510 !! v-points.
4511 real, intent(in) :: dgeo_de !< The constant of proportionality between
4512 !! geopotential and sea surface height [nondim].
4513 ! Local variables
4514 real :: I_dt ! The inverse of the time interval of this call [T-1 ~> s-1].
4515 integer :: i, j, k, is, ie, js, je, n, nz
4516 integer :: isd, ied, jsd, jed, IsdB, IedB, JsdB, JedB
4517 integer :: isdw, iedw, jsdw, jedw
4518 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment !< Open boundary segment
4519
45200 is = G%isc-halo ; ie = G%iec+halo ; js = G%jsc-halo ; je = G%jec+halo
45210 isd = G%isd ; ied = G%ied ; jsd = G%jsd ; jed = G%jed ; nz = GV%ke
45220 IsdB = G%IsdB ; IedB = G%IedB ; JsdB = G%JsdB ; JedB = G%JedB
45230 isdw = MS%isdw ; iedw = MS%iedw ; jsdw = MS%jsdw ; jedw = MS%jedw
4524
45250 I_dt = 1.0 / dt_baroclinic
4526
45270 if (BT_OBC%u_OBCs_on_PE) then
45280 if (OBC%specified_u_BCs_exist_globally) then
45290 do n = 1, OBC%number_of_segments
45300 segment => OBC%segment(n)
45310 if (segment%is_E_or_W .and. segment%specified) then
45320 do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed ; do I=segment%HI%IsdB,segment%HI%IedB
45330 BT_OBC%uhbt(I,j) = 0.
4534 enddo ; enddo
45350 do k=1,nz ; do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed ; do I=segment%HI%IsdB,segment%HI%IedB
45360 BT_OBC%uhbt(I,j) = BT_OBC%uhbt(I,j) + segment%normal_trans(I,j,k)
4537 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
4538 endif
4539 enddo
4540 endif
45410 do j=js,je ; do I=is-1,ie ; if (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) /= 0) then
45420 if (abs(BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j)) == SPECIFIED_OBC) then ! Eastern or western specified OBC
45430 if (integral_BT_cont) then
45440 BT_OBC%ubt_outer(I,j) = uhbt_to_ubt(BT_OBC%uhbt(I,j)*dt_baroclinic, BTCL_u(I,j)) * I_dt
45450 elseif (use_BT_cont) then
45460 BT_OBC%ubt_outer(I,j) = uhbt_to_ubt(BT_OBC%uhbt(I,j), BTCL_u(I,j))
4547 else
45480 if (Datu(I,j) > 0.0) BT_OBC%ubt_outer(I,j) = BT_OBC%uhbt(I,j) / Datu(I,j)
4549 endif
45500 elseif (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) == FLATHER_OBC) then ! Eastern Flather OBC
45510 if (GV%Boussinesq) then
45520 BT_OBC%dZ_u(I,j) = CS%bathyT(i,j) + GV%H_to_Z*eta(i,j)
4553 else
45540 BT_OBC%dZ_u(I,j) = GV%H_to_RZ * eta(i,j) * SpV_avg(i,j)
4555 endif
45560 BT_OBC%Cg_u(I,j) = SQRT(dgeo_de * GV%g_prime(1) * BT_OBC%dZ_u(I,j))
45570 elseif (BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) == -FLATHER_OBC) then ! Western Flather OBC
45580 if (GV%Boussinesq) then
45590 BT_OBC%dZ_u(I,j) = CS%bathyT(i+1,j) + GV%H_to_Z*eta(i+1,j)
4560 else
45610 BT_OBC%dZ_u(I,j) = GV%H_to_RZ * eta(i+1,j) * SpV_avg(i+1,j)
4562 endif
45630 BT_OBC%Cg_u(I,j) = SQRT(dgeo_de * GV%g_prime(1) * BT_OBC%dZ_u(I,j))
4564 endif
4565 endif ; enddo ; enddo
4566
45670 if (OBC%Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally) then
45680 do n = 1, OBC%number_of_segments
45690 segment => OBC%segment(n)
45700 if (segment%is_E_or_W .and. segment%Flather) then
45710 do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed ; do I=segment%HI%IsdB,segment%HI%IedB
45720 BT_OBC%ubt_outer(I,j) = segment%normal_vel_bt(I,j)
45730 BT_OBC%SSH_outer_u(I,j) = segment%SSH(I,j) + G%Z_ref
4574 enddo ; enddo
4575 endif
4576 enddo
4577 endif
4578 endif
4579
45800 if (BT_OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE) then
45810 if (OBC%specified_v_BCs_exist_globally) then
45820 do n = 1, OBC%number_of_segments
45830 segment => OBC%segment(n)
45840 if (segment%is_N_or_S .and. segment%specified) then
45850 do J=segment%HI%JsdB,segment%HI%JedB ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
45860 BT_OBC%vhbt(i,J) = 0.
4587 enddo ; enddo
45880 do k=1,nz ; do J=segment%HI%JsdB,segment%HI%JedB ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
45890 BT_OBC%vhbt(i,J) = BT_OBC%vhbt(i,J) + segment%normal_trans(i,J,k)
4590 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
4591 endif
4592 enddo
4593 endif
45940 do J=js-1,je ; do i=is,ie ; if (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) /= 0) then
45950 if (abs(BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J)) == SPECIFIED_OBC) then ! Northern or southern specified OBC
45960 if (integral_BT_cont) then
45970 BT_OBC%vbt_outer(i,J) = vhbt_to_vbt(BT_OBC%vhbt(i,J)*dt_baroclinic, BTCL_v(i,J)) * I_dt
45980 elseif (use_BT_cont) then
45990 BT_OBC%vbt_outer(i,J) = vhbt_to_vbt(BT_OBC%vhbt(i,J), BTCL_v(i,J))
4600 else
46010 if (Datv(i,J) > 0.0) BT_OBC%vbt_outer(i,J) = BT_OBC%vhbt(i,J) / Datv(i,J)
4602 endif
46030 elseif (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) == FLATHER_OBC) then ! Northern Flather OBC
46040 if (GV%Boussinesq) then
46050 BT_OBC%dZ_v(i,J) = CS%bathyT(i,j) + GV%H_to_Z*eta(i,j)
4606 else
46070 BT_OBC%dZ_v(i,J) = GV%H_to_RZ * eta(i,j) * SpV_avg(i,j)
4608 endif
46090 BT_OBC%Cg_v(i,J) = SQRT(dgeo_de * GV%g_prime(1) * BT_OBC%dZ_v(i,J))
46100 elseif (BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) == -FLATHER_OBC) then ! Southern Flather OBC
46110 if (GV%Boussinesq) then
46120 BT_OBC%dZ_v(i,J) = CS%bathyT(i,j+1) + GV%H_to_Z*eta(i,j+1)
4613 else
46140 BT_OBC%dZ_v(i,J) = GV%H_to_RZ * eta(i,j+1) * SpV_avg(i,j+1)
4615 endif
46160 BT_OBC%Cg_v(i,J) = SQRT(dgeo_de * GV%g_prime(1) * BT_OBC%dZ_v(i,J))
4617 endif
4618 endif ; enddo ; enddo
46190 if (OBC%Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally) then
46200 do n = 1, OBC%number_of_segments
46210 segment => OBC%segment(n)
46220 if (segment%is_N_or_S .and. segment%Flather) then
46230 do J=segment%HI%JsdB,segment%HI%JedB ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
46240 BT_OBC%vbt_outer(i,J) = segment%normal_vel_bt(i,J)
46250 BT_OBC%SSH_outer_v(i,J) = segment%SSH(i,J) + G%Z_ref
4626 enddo ; enddo
4627 endif
4628 enddo
4629 endif
4630 endif
4631
46320 call do_group_pass(BT_OBC%pass_uv, BT_Domain)
46330 if (OBC%Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. OBC%Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally) &
46340 call do_group_pass(BT_OBC%scalar_pass, BT_Domain)
4635
46360end subroutine set_up_BT_OBC
4637
4638!> Clean up the BT_OBC memory.
46391subroutine destroy_BT_OBC(BT_OBC)
4640 type(BT_OBC_type), intent(inout) :: BT_OBC !< A structure with the private barotropic arrays
4641 !! related to the open boundary conditions,
