4643
46441 if (allocated(BT_OBC%u_OBC_type)) deallocate(BT_OBC%u_OBC_type)
46451 if (allocated(BT_OBC%v_OBC_type)) deallocate(BT_OBC%v_OBC_type)
4646
46471 if (allocated(BT_OBC%Cg_u)) deallocate(BT_OBC%Cg_u)
46481 if (allocated(BT_OBC%dZ_u)) deallocate(BT_OBC%dZ_u)
46491 if (allocated(BT_OBC%uhbt)) deallocate(BT_OBC%uhbt)
46501 if (allocated(BT_OBC%ubt_outer)) deallocate(BT_OBC%ubt_outer)
46511 if (allocated(BT_OBC%SSH_outer_u)) deallocate(BT_OBC%SSH_outer_u)
4652
46531 if (allocated(BT_OBC%Cg_v)) deallocate(BT_OBC%Cg_v)
46541 if (allocated(BT_OBC%dZ_v)) deallocate(BT_OBC%dZ_v)
46551 if (allocated(BT_OBC%vhbt)) deallocate(BT_OBC%vhbt)
46561 if (allocated(BT_OBC%vbt_outer)) deallocate(BT_OBC%vbt_outer)
46571 if (allocated(BT_OBC%SSH_outer_v)) deallocate(BT_OBC%SSH_outer_v)
4658
46591end subroutine destroy_BT_OBC
4660
4661!> btcalc determines the fraction of the total water column in each
4662!! layer at velocity points.
46632880subroutine btcalc(h, G, GV, CS, h_u, h_v, may_use_default, OBC)
4664 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
4665 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
4666 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
4667 intent(in) :: h !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
4668 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
4669 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
4670 optional, intent(in) :: h_u !< The specified effective thicknesses at u-points,
4671 !! perhaps scaled down to account for viscosity and
4672 !! fractional open areas [H ~> m or kg m-2]. These
4673 !! are used here as non-normalized weights for each
4674 !! layer that are converted the normalized weights
4675 !! for determining the barotropic accelerations.
4676 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
4677 optional, intent(in) :: h_v !< The specified effective thicknesses at v-points,
4678 !! perhaps scaled down to account for viscosity and
4679 !! fractional open areas [H ~> m or kg m-2]. These
4680 !! are used here as non-normalized weights for each
4681 !! layer that are converted the normalized weights
4682 !! for determining the barotropic accelerations.
4683 logical, optional, intent(in) :: may_use_default !< An optional logical argument
4684 !! to indicate that the default velocity point
4685 !! thicknesses may be used for this particular
4686 !! calculation, even though the setting of
4687 !! CS%hvel_scheme would usually require that h_u
4688 !! and h_v be passed in.
4689 type(ocean_OBC_type), optional, pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure.
4690
4691 ! Local variables
46922882 real :: hatutot(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G)) ! The sum of the layer thicknesses interpolated to u points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
46932882 real :: hatvtot(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G)) ! The sum of the layer thicknesses interpolated to v points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
46942882 real :: Ihatutot(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G)) ! Ihatutot is the inverse of hatutot [H-1 ~> m-1 or m2 kg-1].
46952882 real :: Ihatvtot(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G)) ! Ihatvtot is the inverse of hatvtot [H-1 ~> m-1 or m2 kg-1].
4696 real :: h_arith ! The arithmetic mean thickness [H ~> m or kg m-2].
4697 real :: h_harm ! The harmonic mean thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
4698 real :: h_neglect ! A thickness that is so small it is usually lost
4699 ! in roundoff and can be neglected [H ~> m or kg m-2].
4700 real :: wt_arith ! The weight for the arithmetic mean thickness [nondim].
4701 ! The harmonic mean uses a weight of (1 - wt_arith).
47022882 real :: e_u(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)+1) ! The interface heights at u-velocity points [H ~> m or kg m-2]
47032882 real :: e_v(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)+1) ! The interface heights at v-velocity points [H ~> m or kg m-2]
47041441 real :: D_shallow_u(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G)) ! The height of the shallower of the adjacent bathymetric depths
4705 ! around a u-point (positive upward) [H ~> m or kg m-2]
47061441 real :: D_shallow_v(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G))! The height of the shallower of the adjacent bathymetric depths
4707 ! around a v-point (positive upward) [H ~> m or kg m-2]
4708 real :: Z_to_H ! A local conversion factor [H Z-1 ~> nondim or kg m-3]
4709
4710 logical :: use_default, test_dflt
4711 integer :: is, ie, js, je, Isq, Ieq, Jsq, Jeq, nz, i, j, k
4712
47131441 if (.not.CS%module_is_initialized) call MOM_error(FATAL, &
47140 "btcalc: Module MOM_barotropic must be initialized before it is used.")
4715
47161441 if (.not.CS%split) return
4717
47181441 use_default = .false.
47191441 test_dflt = .false. ; if (present(may_use_default)) test_dflt = may_use_default
4720
47211441 if (test_dflt) then
47221 if (.not.((present(h_u) .and. present(h_v)) .or. &
4723 (CS%hvel_scheme == HARMONIC) .or. (CS%hvel_scheme == HYBRID) .or.&
47241 (CS%hvel_scheme == ARITHMETIC))) use_default = .true.
4725 else
47261440 if (.not.((present(h_u) .and. present(h_v)) .or. &
4727 (CS%hvel_scheme == HARMONIC) .or. (CS%hvel_scheme == HYBRID) .or.&
4728 (CS%hvel_scheme == ARITHMETIC))) call MOM_error(FATAL, &
47290 "btcalc: Inconsistent settings of optional arguments and hvel_scheme.")
4730 endif
4731
47321441 is = G%isc ; ie = G%iec ; js = G%jsc ; je = G%jec ; nz = GV%ke
47331441 Isq = G%IscB ; Ieq = G%IecB ; Jsq = G%JscB ; Jeq = G%JecB
47341441 h_neglect = GV%H_subroundoff
4735
4736 !$omp target enter data map(alloc: hatutot, hatvtot, Ihatutot, Ihatvtot)
4737
47381441 do concurrent (j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
47392660086 hatutot(I,j) = 0.0
4740 enddo
4741
47421441 if (present(h_u)) then
47431440 do concurrent (k=1:nz, j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
474426490336 CS%frhatu(I,j,k) = h_u(I,j,k)
4745 enddo
47461440 do concurrent (j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
474726490336 do k=1,nz
474826484480 hatutot(I,j) = hatutot(I,j) + CS%frhatu(I,j,k)
4749 enddo
4750 enddo
47511 elseif (CS%hvel_scheme == ARITHMETIC) then
47520 do concurrent (k=1:nz, j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
47530 CS%frhatu(I,j,k) = 0.5 * (h(i+1,j,k) + h(i,j,k))
4754 enddo
47550 do concurrent (j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
47560 do k=1,nz
47570 hatutot(I,j) = hatutot(I,j) + CS%frhatu(I,j,k)
4758 enddo
4759 enddo
47601 elseif (CS%hvel_scheme == HYBRID .or. use_default) then
47611 Z_to_H = GV%Z_to_H ; if (.not.GV%Boussinesq) Z_to_H = GV%RZ_to_H * CS%Rho_BT_lin
4762 !$omp target data map(alloc: e_u, D_shallow_u)
47631 do concurrent (j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
476464980 e_u(I,j,nz+1) = -0.5 * Z_to_H * (G%bathyT(i+1,j) + G%bathyT(i,j))
476565342 D_shallow_u(I,j) = -Z_to_H * min(G%bathyT(i+1,j), G%bathyT(i,j))
4766 enddo
476776 do k=nz,1,-1
47681 do concurrent (j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
47691429560 e_u(I,j,K) = e_u(I,j,K+1) + 0.5 * (h(i+1,j,k) + h(i,j,k))
47701429560 h_arith = 0.5 * (h(i+1,j,k) + h(i,j,k))
47711429560 if (e_u(I,j,K+1) >= D_shallow_u(I,j)) then
47721306952 CS%frhatu(I,j,k) = h_arith
4773 else
4774132962 h_harm = (h(i+1,j,k) * h(i,j,k)) / (h_arith + h_neglect)
4775132962 if (e_u(I,j,K) <= D_shallow_u(I,j)) then
4776127894 CS%frhatu(I,j,k) = h_harm
4777 else
477846348 wt_arith = (e_u(I,j,K) - D_shallow_u(I,j)) / (h_arith + h_neglect)
477946348 CS%frhatu(I,j,k) = wt_arith*h_arith + (1.0-wt_arith)*h_harm
4780 endif
4781 endif
47821437524 hatutot(I,j) = hatutot(I,j) + CS%frhatu(I,j,k)
4783 enddo
4784 enddo
4785 !$omp end target data
47860 elseif (CS%hvel_scheme == HARMONIC) then
4787 ! Interpolates thicknesses onto u grid points with the
4788 ! second order accurate estimate h = 2*(h+ * h-)/(h+ + h-).
47890 do concurrent (k=1:nz, j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
4790 CS%frhatu(I,j,k) = 2.0*(h(i+1,j,k) * h(i,j,k)) / &
47910 ((h(i+1,j,k) + h(i,j,k)) + h_neglect)
4792 enddo
47930 do concurrent (j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
47940 do k=1,nz
47950 hatutot(I,j) = hatutot(I,j) + CS%frhatu(I,j,k)
4796 enddo
4797 enddo
4798 endif
4799
48001441 if (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBCs_on_PE) then
4801 ! todo: put i,j iterations into single do concurrent
48020 do concurrent (j=js:je)
4803 ! Reset velocity point thicknesses and their sums at OBC points
48040 if ((j >= CS%BT_OBC%js_u_E_obc) .and. (j <= CS%BT_OBC%je_u_E_obc)) then
4805 !$omp do
48060 do I = max(is-1,CS%BT_OBC%Is_u_E_obc), min(ie,CS%BT_OBC%Ie_u_E_obc)
48070 if (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) > 0) then ! Eastern boundary condition
48080 hatutot(I,j) = 0.0
48090 do k=1,nz
48100 CS%frhatu(I,j,k) = h(i,j,k)
48110 hatutot(I,j) = hatutot(I,j) + CS%frhatu(I,j,k)
4812 enddo
4813 endif
4814 enddo
4815 endif
48160 if ((j >= CS%BT_OBC%js_u_W_obc) .and. (j <= CS%BT_OBC%je_u_W_obc)) then
4817 !$omp do
48180 do I = max(is-1,CS%BT_OBC%Is_u_W_obc), min(ie,CS%BT_OBC%Ie_u_W_obc)
48190 if (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) < 0) then ! Western boundary condition
48200 hatutot(I,j) = 0.0
48210 do k=1,nz
48220 CS%frhatu(I,j,k) = h(i+1,j,k)
48230 hatutot(I,j) = hatutot(I,j) + CS%frhatu(I,j,k)
4824 enddo
4825 endif
4826 enddo
4827 endif
4828 enddo
4829 endif
4830
4831 ! Determine the fractional thickness of each layer at the velocity points.
48321441 do concurrent (j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
48332660086 Ihatutot(I,j) = G%mask2dCu(I,j) / (hatutot(I,j) + h_neglect)
4834 enddo
48351441 do concurrent (k=1:nz, j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
483627042218 CS%frhatu(I,j,k) = CS%frhatu(I,j,k) * Ihatutot(I,j)
4837 enddo
4838
48391441 do concurrent (J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
48402664409 hatvtot(i,J) = 0.0
4841 enddo
4842
48431441 if (present(h_v)) then
48441440 do concurrent (k=1:nz, J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
484526709168 CS%frhatv(i,J,k) = h_v(i,J,k)
4846 enddo
48471440 do concurrent (J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
484826709168 do k=1,nz
484926703360 hatvtot(i,J) = hatvtot(i,J) + CS%frhatv(i,J,k)
4850 enddo
4851 enddo
48521 elseif (CS%hvel_scheme == ARITHMETIC) then
48530 do concurrent (k=1:nz, J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
48540 CS%frhatv(i,J,k) = 0.5 * (h(i,j+1,k) + h(i,j,k))
4855 enddo
48560 do concurrent (J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
48570 do k=1,nz
48580 hatvtot(i,J) = hatvtot(i,J) + CS%frhatv(i,J,k)
4859 enddo
4860 enddo
48611 elseif (CS%hvel_scheme == HYBRID .or. use_default) then
48621 Z_to_H = GV%Z_to_H ; if (.not.GV%Boussinesq) Z_to_H = GV%RZ_to_H * CS%Rho_BT_lin
4863 !$omp target data map(alloc: e_v, D_shallow_v)
48641 do concurrent (J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
486565160 e_v(i,J,nz+1) = -0.5 * Z_to_H * (G%bathyT(i,j+1) + G%bathyT(i,j))
486665521 D_shallow_v(i,J) = -Z_to_H * min(G%bathyT(i,j+1), G%bathyT(i,j))
4867 enddo
486876 do k=nz,1,-1
48691 do concurrent (J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
48701433520 e_v(i,J,K) = e_v(i,J,K+1) + 0.5 * (h(i,j+1,k) + h(i,j,k))
48711433520 h_arith = 0.5 * (h(i,j+1,k) + h(i,j,k))
48721433520 if (e_v(i,J,K+1) >= D_shallow_v(i,J)) then
48731306304 CS%frhatv(i,J,k) = h_arith
4874 else
4875137386 h_harm = (h(i,j+1,k) * h(i,j,k)) / (h_arith + h_neglect)
4876137386 if (e_v(i,J,K) <= D_shallow_v(i,J)) then
4877132252 CS%frhatv(i,J,k) = h_harm
4878 else
487946610 wt_arith = (e_v(i,J,K) - D_shallow_v(i,J)) / (h_arith + h_neglect)
488046610 CS%frhatv(i,J,k) = wt_arith*h_arith + (1.0-wt_arith)*h_harm
4881 endif
4882 endif
48831441462 hatvtot(i,J) = hatvtot(i,J) + CS%frhatv(i,J,k)
4884 enddo
4885 enddo
4886 !$omp end target data
48870 elseif (CS%hvel_scheme == HARMONIC) then
48880 do concurrent (k=1:nz, J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
4889 CS%frhatv(i,J,k) = 2.0*(h(i,j+1,k) * h(i,j,k)) / &
48900 ((h(i,j+1,k) + h(i,j,k)) + h_neglect)
4891 enddo
48920 do concurrent (J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
48930 do k=1,nz
48940 hatvtot(i,J) = hatvtot(i,J) + CS%frhatv(i,J,k)
4895 enddo
4896 enddo
4897 endif
4898
48991441 if (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE) then
4900 ! todo: put i,j iterations into single do concurrent
49010 do concurrent (J=js-1:je)
4902 ! Reset v-velocity point thicknesses and their sums at OBC points
49030 if ((J >= CS%BT_OBC%Js_v_N_obc) .and. (J <= CS%BT_OBC%Je_v_N_obc)) then
4904 !$omp do simd
49050 do i = max(is,CS%BT_OBC%is_v_N_obc), min(ie,CS%BT_OBC%ie_v_N_obc)
49060 if (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) > 0) then ! Northern boundary condition
49070 hatvtot(i,J) = 0.0
49080 do k=1,nz
49090 CS%frhatv(i,J,k) = h(i,j,k)
49100 hatvtot(i,J) = hatvtot(i,J) + CS%frhatv(i,J,k)
4911 enddo
4912 endif
4913 enddo
4914 endif
49150 if ((J >= CS%BT_OBC%Js_v_S_obc) .and. (J <= CS%BT_OBC%Je_v_S_obc)) then
4916 !$omp do simd
49170 do i = max(is,CS%BT_OBC%is_v_S_obc), min(ie,CS%BT_OBC%ie_v_S_obc)
49180 if (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) < 0) then ! Southern boundary condition
49190 hatvtot(i,J) = 0.0
49200 do k=1,nz
49210 CS%frhatv(i,J,k) = h(i,j+1,k)
49220 hatvtot(i,J) = hatvtot(i,J) + CS%frhatv(i,J,k)
4923 enddo
4924 endif
4925 enddo
4926 endif
4927 enddo
4928 endif
4929
4930 ! Determine the fractional thickness of each layer at the velocity points.
49311441 do concurrent (J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
49322664409 Ihatvtot(i,J) = G%mask2dCv(i,J) / (hatvtot(i,J) + h_neglect)
4933 enddo
49341441 do concurrent (k=1:nz, J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
493527265609 CS%frhatv(i,J,k) = CS%frhatv(i,J,k) * Ihatvtot(i,J)
4936 enddo
4937
4938 !$omp target exit data map(delete: hatutot, hatvtot, Ihatutot, Ihatvtot)
4939
49401441 if (CS%debug) then
4941 !$omp target update from(CS%frhatu, CS%frhatv)
4942 call uvchksum("btcalc frhat[uv]", CS%frhatu, CS%frhatv, G%HI, &
4943 haloshift=0, symmetric=.true., omit_corners=.true., &
49440 scalar_pair=.true.)
4945
49460 if (present(h_u) .and. present(h_v)) then
4947 !$omp target update from(h_u, h_v)
4948 call uvchksum("btcalc h_[uv]", h_u, h_v, G%HI, haloshift=0, &
4949 symmetric=.true., omit_corners=.true., unscale=GV%H_to_MKS, &
49500 scalar_pair=.true.)
4951 endif
4952
49530 call hchksum(h, "btcalc h", G%HI, haloshift=1, unscale=GV%H_to_MKS)
4954 endif
49552881end subroutine btcalc

4957!> The function find_uhbt determines the zonal transport for a given velocity, or with
4958!! INTEGRAL_BT_CONT=True it determines the time-integrated zonal transport for a given
4959!! time-integrated velocity.
496017040384pure function find_uhbt(u, BTC) result(uhbt)
4961 real, intent(in) :: u !< The local zonal velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1] or time integrated velocity [L ~> m]
4962 type(local_BT_cont_u_type), intent(in) :: BTC !< A structure containing various fields that
4963 !! allow the barotropic transports to be calculated consistently
4964 !! with the layers' continuity equations. The dimensions of some
4965 !! of the elements in this type vary depending on INTEGRAL_BT_CONT.
4966
4967 real :: uhbt !< The zonal barotropic transport [L2 H T-1 ~> m3 s-1] or time integrated transport [L2 H ~> m3]
4968
496917040384 if (u == 0.0) then
49702979411 uhbt = 0.0
497114913224 elseif (u < BTC%uBT_EE) then
49726587044 uhbt = (u - BTC%uBT_EE) * BTC%FA_u_EE + BTC%uh_EE
49738326180 elseif (u < 0.0) then
49744827279 uhbt = u * (BTC%FA_u_E0 + BTC%uh_crvE * u**2)
49757921948 elseif (u <= BTC%uBT_WW) then
49762087697 uhbt = u * (BTC%FA_u_W0 + BTC%uh_crvW * u**2)
4977 else ! (u > BTC%uBT_WW)
49787340287 uhbt = (u - BTC%uBT_WW) * BTC%FA_u_WW + BTC%uh_WW
4979 endif
4980
498117040384end function find_uhbt
4982
4983!> The function find_duhbt_du determines the marginal zonal face area for a given velocity, or
4984!! with INTEGRAL_BT_CONT=True for a given time-integrated velocity.
49850pure function find_duhbt_du(u, BTC) result(duhbt_du)
4986 real, intent(in) :: u !< The local zonal velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1] or time integrated velocity [L ~> m]
4987 type(local_BT_cont_u_type), intent(in) :: BTC !< A structure containing various fields that
4988 !! allow the barotropic transports to be calculated consistently
4989 !! with the layers' continuity equations. The dimensions of some
4990 !! of the elements in this type vary depending on INTEGRAL_BT_CONT.
4991 real :: duhbt_du !< The zonal barotropic face area [L H ~> m2 or kg m-1]
4992
49930 if (u == 0.0) then
49940 duhbt_du = 0.5*(BTC%FA_u_E0 + BTC%FA_u_W0) ! Note the potential discontinuity here.
49950 elseif (u < BTC%uBT_EE) then
49960 duhbt_du = BTC%FA_u_EE
49970 elseif (u < 0.0) then
49980 duhbt_du = (BTC%FA_u_E0 + 3.0*BTC%uh_crvE * u**2)
49990 elseif (u <= BTC%uBT_WW) then
50000 duhbt_du = (BTC%FA_u_W0 + 3.0*BTC%uh_crvW * u**2)
5001 else ! (u > BTC%uBT_WW)
50020 duhbt_du = BTC%FA_u_WW
5003 endif
5004
50050end function find_duhbt_du
5006
5007!> This function inverts the transport function to determine the barotopic
5008!! velocity that is consistent with a given transport, or if INTEGRAL_BT_CONT=True
5009!! this finds the time-integrated velocity that is consistent with a time-integrated transport.
50100function uhbt_to_ubt(uhbt, BTC) result(ubt)
5011 real, intent(in) :: uhbt !< The barotropic zonal transport that should be inverted for,
5012 !! [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1] or the time-integrated
5013 !! transport [H L2 ~> m3 or kg].
5014 type(local_BT_cont_u_type), intent(in) :: BTC !< A structure containing various fields that allow the
5015 !! barotropic transports to be calculated consistently with the
5016 !! layers' continuity equations. The dimensions of some
5017 !! of the elements in this type vary depending on INTEGRAL_BT_CONT.
5018 real :: ubt !< The result - The velocity that gives uhbt transport [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
5019 !! or the time-integrated velocity [L ~> m].
5020
5021 ! Local variables
5022 real :: ubt_min, ubt_max ! Bounding values of vbt [L T-1 ~> m s-1] or [L ~> m]
5023 real :: uhbt_err ! The transport error [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1] or [H L2 ~> m3 or kg].
5024 real :: derr_du ! The change in transport error with vbt, i.e. the face area [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
5025 real :: uherr_min, uherr_max ! The bounding values of the transport error [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1]
5026 ! or [H L2 ~> m3 or kg].
5027 real, parameter :: tol = 1.0e-10 ! A fractional match tolerance [nondim]
5028 real, parameter :: vs1 = 1.25 ! Nondimensional parameters used in limiting
5029 real, parameter :: vs2 = 2.0 ! the velocity, starting at vs1, with the
5030 ! maximum increase of vs2, both [nondim].
5031 integer :: itt, max_itt = 20
5032
5033 ! Find the value of ubt that gives uhbt.
50340 if (uhbt == 0.0) then
50350 ubt = 0.0
50360 elseif (uhbt < BTC%uh_EE) then
50370 ubt = BTC%uBT_EE + (uhbt - BTC%uh_EE) / BTC%FA_u_EE
50380 elseif (uhbt < 0.0) then
5039 ! Iterate to convergence with Newton's method (when bounded) and the
5040 ! false position method otherwise. ubt will be negative.
50410 ubt_min = BTC%uBT_EE ; uherr_min = BTC%uh_EE - uhbt
50420 ubt_max = 0.0 ; uherr_max = -uhbt
5043 ! Use a false-position method first guess.
50440 ubt = BTC%uBT_EE * (uhbt / BTC%uh_EE)
50450 do itt = 1, max_itt
50460 uhbt_err = ubt * (BTC%FA_u_E0 + BTC%uh_crvE * ubt**2) - uhbt
5047
50480 if (abs(uhbt_err) < tol*abs(uhbt)) exit
50490 if (uhbt_err > 0.0) then ; ubt_max = ubt ; uherr_max = uhbt_err ; endif
50500 if (uhbt_err < 0.0) then ; ubt_min = ubt ; uherr_min = uhbt_err ; endif
5051
50520 derr_du = BTC%FA_u_E0 + 3.0 * BTC%uh_crvE * ubt**2
5053 if ((uhbt_err >= derr_du*(ubt - ubt_min)) .or. &
50540 (-uhbt_err >= derr_du*(ubt_max - ubt)) .or. (derr_du <= 0.0)) then
5055 ! Use a false-position method guess.
50560 ubt = ubt_max + (ubt_min-ubt_max) * (uherr_max / (uherr_max-uherr_min))
5057 else ! Use Newton's method.
50580 ubt = ubt - uhbt_err / derr_du
50590 if (abs(uhbt_err) < (0.01*tol)*abs(ubt_min*derr_du)) exit
5060 endif
5061 enddo
50620 elseif (uhbt <= BTC%uh_WW) then
5063 ! Iterate to convergence with Newton's method. ubt will be positive.
50640 ubt_min = 0.0 ; uherr_min = -uhbt
50650 ubt_max = BTC%uBT_WW ; uherr_max = BTC%uh_WW - uhbt
5066 ! Use a false-position method first guess.
50670 ubt = BTC%uBT_WW * (uhbt / BTC%uh_WW)
50680 do itt = 1, max_itt
50690 uhbt_err = ubt * (BTC%FA_u_W0 + BTC%uh_crvW * ubt**2) - uhbt
5070
50710 if (abs(uhbt_err) < tol*abs(uhbt)) exit
50720 if (uhbt_err > 0.0) then ; ubt_max = ubt ; uherr_max = uhbt_err ; endif
50730 if (uhbt_err < 0.0) then ; ubt_min = ubt ; uherr_min = uhbt_err ; endif
5074
50750 derr_du = BTC%FA_u_W0 + 3.0 * BTC%uh_crvW * ubt**2
5076 if ((uhbt_err >= derr_du*(ubt - ubt_min)) .or. &
50770 (-uhbt_err >= derr_du*(ubt_max - ubt)) .or. (derr_du <= 0.0)) then
5078 ! Use a false-position method guess.
50790 ubt = ubt_min + (ubt_max-ubt_min) * (-uherr_min / (uherr_max-uherr_min))
5080 else ! Use Newton's method.
50810 ubt = ubt - uhbt_err / derr_du
50820 if (abs(uhbt_err) < (0.01*tol)*(ubt_max*derr_du)) exit
5083 endif
5084 enddo
5085 else ! (uhbt > BTC%uh_WW)
50860 ubt = BTC%uBT_WW + (uhbt - BTC%uh_WW) / BTC%FA_u_WW
5087 endif
5088
50890end function uhbt_to_ubt

5091!> The function find_vhbt determines the meridional transport for a given velocity, or with

5140!> This function inverts the transport function to determine the barotopic
5141!! velocity that is consistent with a given transport, or if INTEGRAL_BT_CONT=True
5142!! this finds the time-integrated velocity that is consistent with a time-integrated transport.
51430function vhbt_to_vbt(vhbt, BTC) result(vbt)
5144 real, intent(in) :: vhbt !< The barotropic meridional transport that should be
5145 !! inverted for [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1] or the
5146 !! time-integrated transport [H L2 ~> m3 or kg].
5147 type(local_BT_cont_v_type), intent(in) :: BTC !< A structure containing various fields that allow the
5148 !! barotropic transports to be calculated consistently
5149 !! with the layers' continuity equations. The dimensions of some
5150 !! of the elements in this type vary depending on INTEGRAL_BT_CONT.
5151 real :: vbt !< The result - The velocity that gives vhbt transport [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
5152 !! or the time-integrated velocity [L ~> m].
5153
5154 ! Local variables
5155 real :: vbt_min, vbt_max ! Bounding values of vbt [L T-1 ~> m s-1] or [L ~> m]
5156 real :: vhbt_err ! The transport error [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1] or [H L2 ~> m3 or kg].
5157 real :: derr_dv ! The change in transport error with vbt, i.e. the face area [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
5158 real :: vherr_min, vherr_max ! The bounding values of the transport error [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1]
5159 ! or [H L2 ~> m3 or kg].
5160 real, parameter :: tol = 1.0e-10 ! A fractional match tolerance [nondim]
5161 real, parameter :: vs1 = 1.25 ! Nondimensional parameters used in limiting
5162 real, parameter :: vs2 = 2.0 ! the velocity, starting at vs1, with the
5163 ! maximum increase of vs2, both [nondim].
5164 integer :: itt, max_itt = 20
5165
5166 ! Find the value of vbt that gives vhbt.
51670 if (vhbt == 0.0) then
51680 vbt = 0.0
51690 elseif (vhbt < BTC%vh_NN) then
51700 vbt = BTC%vBT_NN + (vhbt - BTC%vh_NN) / BTC%FA_v_NN
51710 elseif (vhbt < 0.0) then
5172 ! Iterate to convergence with Newton's method (when bounded) and the
5173 ! false position method otherwise. vbt will be negative.
51740 vbt_min = BTC%vBT_NN ; vherr_min = BTC%vh_NN - vhbt
51750 vbt_max = 0.0 ; vherr_max = -vhbt
5176 ! Use a false-position method first guess.
51770 vbt = BTC%vBT_NN * (vhbt / BTC%vh_NN)
51780 do itt = 1, max_itt
51790 vhbt_err = vbt * (BTC%FA_v_N0 + BTC%vh_crvN * vbt**2) - vhbt
5180
51810 if (abs(vhbt_err) < tol*abs(vhbt)) exit
51820 if (vhbt_err > 0.0) then ; vbt_max = vbt ; vherr_max = vhbt_err ; endif
51830 if (vhbt_err < 0.0) then ; vbt_min = vbt ; vherr_min = vhbt_err ; endif
5184
51850 derr_dv = BTC%FA_v_N0 + 3.0 * BTC%vh_crvN * vbt**2
5186 if ((vhbt_err >= derr_dv*(vbt - vbt_min)) .or. &
51870 (-vhbt_err >= derr_dv*(vbt_max - vbt)) .or. (derr_dv <= 0.0)) then
5188 ! Use a false-position method guess.
51890 vbt = vbt_max + (vbt_min-vbt_max) * (vherr_max / (vherr_max-vherr_min))
5190 else ! Use Newton's method.
51910 vbt = vbt - vhbt_err / derr_dv
51920 if (abs(vhbt_err) < (0.01*tol)*abs(derr_dv*vbt_min)) exit
5193 endif
5194 enddo
51950 elseif (vhbt <= BTC%vh_SS) then
5196 ! Iterate to convergence with Newton's method. vbt will be positive.
51970 vbt_min = 0.0 ; vherr_min = -vhbt
51980 vbt_max = BTC%vBT_SS ; vherr_max = BTC%vh_SS - vhbt
5199 ! Use a false-position method first guess.
52000 vbt = BTC%vBT_SS * (vhbt / BTC%vh_SS)
52010 do itt = 1, max_itt
52020 vhbt_err = vbt * (BTC%FA_v_S0 + BTC%vh_crvS * vbt**2) - vhbt
5203
52040 if (abs(vhbt_err) < tol*abs(vhbt)) exit
52050 if (vhbt_err > 0.0) then ; vbt_max = vbt ; vherr_max = vhbt_err ; endif
52060 if (vhbt_err < 0.0) then ; vbt_min = vbt ; vherr_min = vhbt_err ; endif
5207
52080 derr_dv = BTC%FA_v_S0 + 3.0 * BTC%vh_crvS * vbt**2
5209 if ((vhbt_err >= derr_dv*(vbt - vbt_min)) .or. &
52100 (-vhbt_err >= derr_dv*(vbt_max - vbt)) .or. (derr_dv <= 0.0)) then
5211 ! Use a false-position method guess.
52120 vbt = vbt_min + (vbt_max-vbt_min) * (-vherr_min / (vherr_max-vherr_min))
5213 else ! Use Newton's method.
52140 vbt = vbt - vhbt_err / derr_dv
52150 if (abs(vhbt_err) < (0.01*tol)*(vbt_max*derr_dv)) exit
5216 endif
5217 enddo
5218 else ! (vhbt > BTC%vh_SS)
52190 vbt = BTC%vBT_SS + (vhbt - BTC%vh_SS) / BTC%FA_v_SS
5220 endif
5221
52220end function vhbt_to_vbt
5223
5224!> This subroutine sets up reordered versions of the BT_cont type in the
5225!! local_BT_cont types, which have wide halos properly filled in.
52261440subroutine set_local_BT_cont_types(BT_cont, BTCL_u, BTCL_v, G, US, MS, BT_Domain, halo, dt_baroclinic)
5227 type(BT_cont_type), intent(inout) :: BT_cont !< The BT_cont_type input to the barotropic solver
5228 type(memory_size_type), intent(in) :: MS !< A type that describes the memory sizes of
5229 !! the argument arrays
5230 type(local_BT_cont_u_type), dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), &
5231 intent(out) :: BTCL_u !< A structure with the u information from BT_cont
5232 type(local_BT_cont_v_type), dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), &
5233 intent(out) :: BTCL_v !< A structure with the v information from BT_cont
5234 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure
5235 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
5236 type(MOM_domain_type), intent(inout) :: BT_Domain !< The domain to use for updating the halos
5237 !! of wide arrays
5238 integer, intent(in) :: halo !< The extra halo size to use here
5239 real, optional, intent(in) :: dt_baroclinic !< The baroclinic time step [T ~> s], which
5240 !! is provided if INTEGRAL_BT_CONTINUITY is true.
5241
5242 ! Local variables
5243 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)) :: &
52442880 u_polarity, & ! An array used to test for halo update polarity [nondim]
52452880 uBT_EE, uBT_WW, & ! Zonal velocities at which the form of the fit changes [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
52462880 FA_u_EE, FA_u_E0, FA_u_W0, FA_u_WW ! Zonal face areas [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1]
5247 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)) :: &
52482880 v_polarity, & ! An array used to test for halo update polarity [nondim]
52492880 vBT_NN, vBT_SS, & ! Meridional velocities at which the form of the fit changes [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
52502880 FA_v_NN, FA_v_N0, FA_v_S0, FA_v_SS ! Meridional face areas [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1]
5251 real :: dt ! The baroclinic timestep [T ~> s] or 1.0 [nondim]
5252 real, parameter :: C1_3 = 1.0/3.0 ! [nondim]
5253 integer :: i, j, is, ie, js, je, hs
5254 real :: tmp
5255
52561440 is = G%isc ; ie = G%iec ; js = G%jsc ; je = G%jec
52571440 hs = max(halo,0)
52581440 dt = 1.0 ; if (present(dt_baroclinic)) dt = dt_baroclinic
5259
5260 !$omp target enter data &
5261 !$omp map(alloc: u_polarity, uBT_EE, uBT_WW, FA_u_EE, FA_u_E0, FA_u_W0, FA_u_WW, &
5262 !$omp v_polarity, vBT_NN, vBT_SS, FA_v_NN, FA_v_N0, FA_v_S0, FA_v_SS)
5263
5264 ! Copy the BT_cont arrays into symmetric, potentially wide haloed arrays.
526577760 do concurrent (j=js-hs:je+hs, i=is-hs-1:ie+hs)
52663663360 u_polarity(i,j) = 1.0
52673663360 uBT_EE(i,j) = 0.0 ; uBT_WW(i,j) = 0.0
52683741120 FA_u_EE(i,j) = 0.0 ; FA_u_E0(i,j) = 0.0 ; FA_u_W0(i,j) = 0.0 ; FA_u_WW(i,j) = 0.0
5269 enddo
527076320 do concurrent (j=js-hs-1:je+hs, i=is-hs:ie+hs)
52713669120 v_polarity(i,j) = 1.0
52723669120 vBT_NN(i,j) = 0.0 ; vBT_SS(i,j) = 0.0
52733745440 FA_v_NN(i,j) = 0.0 ; FA_v_N0(i,j) = 0.0 ; FA_v_S0(i,j) = 0.0 ; FA_v_SS(i,j) = 0.0
5274 enddo
52751440 do concurrent (j=js:je, I=is-1:ie)
52762592000 uBT_EE(I,j) = BT_cont%uBT_EE(I,j) ; uBT_WW(I,j) = BT_cont%uBT_WW(I,j)
52772592000 FA_u_EE(I,j) = BT_cont%FA_u_EE(I,j) ; FA_u_E0(I,j) = BT_cont%FA_u_E0(I,j)
52782658240 FA_u_W0(I,j) = BT_cont%FA_u_W0(I,j) ; FA_u_WW(I,j) = BT_cont%FA_u_WW(I,j)
5279 enddo
52801440 do concurrent (J=js-1:je, i=is:ie)
52812597760 vBT_NN(i,J) = BT_cont%vBT_NN(i,J) ; vBT_SS(i,J) = BT_cont%vBT_SS(i,J)
52822597760 FA_v_NN(i,J) = BT_cont%FA_v_NN(i,J) ; FA_v_N0(i,J) = BT_cont%FA_v_N0(i,J)
52832662560 FA_v_S0(i,J) = BT_cont%FA_v_S0(i,J) ; FA_v_SS(i,J) = BT_cont%FA_v_SS(i,J)
5284 enddo
5285
52861440 if (id_clock_calc_pre > 0) call cpu_clock_end(id_clock_calc_pre)
52871440 if (id_clock_pass_pre > 0) call cpu_clock_begin(id_clock_pass_pre)
5288!--- begin setup for group halo update
52891440 call create_group_pass(BT_cont%pass_polarity_BT, u_polarity, v_polarity, BT_Domain)
52901440 call create_group_pass(BT_cont%pass_polarity_BT, uBT_EE, vBT_NN, BT_Domain)
52911440 call create_group_pass(BT_cont%pass_polarity_BT, uBT_WW, vBT_SS, BT_Domain)
5292
52931440 call create_group_pass(BT_cont%pass_FA_uv, FA_u_EE, FA_v_NN, BT_Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
52941440 call create_group_pass(BT_cont%pass_FA_uv, FA_u_E0, FA_v_N0, BT_Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
52951440 call create_group_pass(BT_cont%pass_FA_uv, FA_u_W0, FA_v_S0, BT_Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
52961440 call create_group_pass(BT_cont%pass_FA_uv, FA_u_WW, FA_v_SS, BT_Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
5297!--- end setup for group halo update
5298 ! Do halo updates on BT_cont.
5299 ! data update directives for MPI transfers (via CPU) needed even for serial
53001440 call do_group_pass(BT_cont%pass_polarity_BT, BT_Domain, omp_offload=.true.)
53011440 call do_group_pass(BT_cont%pass_FA_uv, BT_Domain, omp_offload=.true.)
53021440 if (id_clock_pass_pre > 0) call cpu_clock_end(id_clock_pass_pre)
53031440 if (id_clock_calc_pre > 0) call cpu_clock_begin(id_clock_calc_pre)
5304
530577760 do concurrent (j=js-hs:je+hs, I=is-hs-1:ie+hs)
53063663360 BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_EE = FA_u_EE(I,j) ; BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_E0 = FA_u_E0(I,j)
53073663360 BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_W0 = FA_u_W0(I,j) ; BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_WW = FA_u_WW(I,j)
53083663360 BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_EE = dt*uBT_EE(I,j) ; BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_WW = dt*uBT_WW(I,j)
5309 ! Check for reversed polarity in the tripolar halo regions.
53103663360 if (u_polarity(I,j) < 0.0) then
53110 tmp = BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_EE
53120 BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_EE = BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_WW
53130 BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_WW = tmp
5314
53150 tmp = BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_E0
53160 BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_E0 = BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_W0
53170 BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_W0 = tmp
5318
53190 tmp = BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_EE
53200 BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_EE = BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_WW
53210 BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_WW = tmp
5322 endif
5323
5324 BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_EE = BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_EE * &
53253663360 (C1_3 * (2.0*BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_E0 + BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_EE))
5326 BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_WW = BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_WW * &
53273663360 (C1_3 * (2.0*BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_W0 + BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_WW))
5328
53293663360 BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_crvE = 0.0 ; BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_crvW = 0.0
53303663360 if (abs(BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_WW) > 0.0) BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_crvW = &
53312454777 (C1_3 * (BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_WW - BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_W0)) / BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_WW**2
53323663360 if (abs(BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_EE) > 0.0) BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_crvE = &
53333741120 (C1_3 * (BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_EE - BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_E0)) / BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_EE**2
5334 enddo
5335
533676320 do concurrent (J=js-hs-1:je+hs, i=is-hs:ie+hs)
53373669120 BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_NN = FA_v_NN(i,J) ; BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_N0 = FA_v_N0(i,J)
53383669120 BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_S0 = FA_v_S0(i,J) ; BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_SS = FA_v_SS(i,J)
53393669120 BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_NN = dt*vBT_NN(i,J) ; BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_SS = dt*vBT_SS(i,J)
5340 ! Check for reversed polarity in the tripolar halo regions.
53413669120 if (v_polarity(i,J) < 0.0) then
53420 tmp = BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_NN
53430 BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_NN = BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_SS
53440 BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_SS = tmp
5345
53460 tmp = BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_N0
53470 BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_N0 = BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_S0
53480 BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_S0 = tmp
5349
53500 tmp = BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_NN
53510 BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_NN = BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_SS
53520 BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_SS = tmp
5353 endif
5354
5355 BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_NN = BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_NN * &
53563669120 (C1_3 * (2.0*BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_N0 + BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_NN))
5357 BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_SS = BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_SS * &
53583669120 (C1_3 * (2.0*BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_S0 + BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_SS))
5359
53603669120 BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_crvN = 0.0 ; BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_crvS = 0.0
53613669120 if (abs(BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_SS) > 0.0) BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_crvS = &
53622460098 (C1_3 * (BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_SS - BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_S0)) / BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_SS**2
53633669120 if (abs(BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_NN) > 0.0) BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_crvN = &
53643745440 (C1_3 * (BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_NN - BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_N0)) / BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_NN**2
5365 enddo
5366
5367 !$omp target exit data &
5368 !$omp map(release: u_polarity, uBT_EE, uBT_WW, FA_u_EE, FA_u_E0, FA_u_W0, FA_u_WW, &
5369 !$omp v_polarity, vBT_NN, vBT_SS, FA_v_NN, FA_v_N0, FA_v_S0, FA_v_SS)
53701440end subroutine set_local_BT_cont_types
5371
5372
5373!> Adjust_local_BT_cont_types expands the range of velocities with a cubic curve
5374!! translating velocities into transports to match the initial values of velocities and
5375!! summed transports when the velocities are larger than the first guesses of the cubic
5376!! transition velocities used to set up the local_BT_cont types.
53770subroutine adjust_local_BT_cont_types(ubt, uhbt, vbt, vhbt, BTCL_u, BTCL_v, &
5378 G, US, MS, halo, dt_baroclinic)
5379 type(memory_size_type), intent(in) :: MS !< A type that describes the memory sizes of the argument arrays.
5380 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), &
5381 intent(in) :: ubt !< The linearization zonal barotropic velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
5382 real, dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), &
5383 intent(in) :: uhbt !< The linearization zonal barotropic transport
5384 !! [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1].
5385 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), &
5386 intent(in) :: vbt !< The linearization meridional barotropic velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
5387 real, dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), &
5388 intent(in) :: vhbt !< The linearization meridional barotropic transport
5389 !! [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1 or kg s-1].
5390 type(local_BT_cont_u_type), dimension(SZIBW_(MS),SZJW_(MS)), &
5391 intent(out) :: BTCL_u !< A structure with the u information from BT_cont.
5392 type(local_BT_cont_v_type), dimension(SZIW_(MS),SZJBW_(MS)), &
5393 intent(out) :: BTCL_v !< A structure with the v information from BT_cont.
5394 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
5395 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
5396 integer, intent(in) :: halo !< The extra halo size to use here.
5397 real, optional, intent(in) :: dt_baroclinic !< The baroclinic time step [T ~> s], which is
5398 !! provided if INTEGRAL_BT_CONTINUITY is true.
5399
5400 ! Local variables
5401 real :: dt ! The baroclinic timestep [T ~> s] or 1.0 [nondim]
5402 real, parameter :: C1_3 = 1.0/3.0 ! [nondim]
5403 integer :: i, j, is, ie, js, je, hs
5404
54050 is = G%isc ; ie = G%iec ; js = G%jsc ; je = G%jec
54060 hs = max(halo,0)
54070 dt = 1.0 ; if (present(dt_baroclinic)) dt = dt_baroclinic
5408
5409 !$OMP parallel do default(shared)
54100 do j=js-hs,je+hs ; do I=is-hs-1,ie+hs
54110 if ((dt*ubt(I,j) > BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_WW) .and. (dt*uhbt(I,j) > BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_WW)) then
5412 ! Expand the cubic fit to use this new point. ubt is negative.
54130 BTCL_u(I,j)%ubt_WW = dt * ubt(I,j)
54140 if (3.0*uhbt(I,j) < 2.0*ubt(I,j) * BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_W0) then
5415 ! No further bounding is needed.
54160 BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_crvW = (uhbt(I,j) - ubt(I,j) * BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_W0) / (dt**2 * ubt(I,j)**3)
5417 else ! This should not happen often!
54180 BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_W0 = 1.5*uhbt(I,j) / ubt(I,j)
54190 BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_crvW = -0.5*uhbt(I,j) / (dt**2 * ubt(I,j)**3)
5420 endif
54210 BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_WW = dt * uhbt(I,j)
5422 ! I don't know whether this is helpful.
5423! BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_WW = min(BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_WW, uhbt(I,j) / ubt(I,j))
54240 elseif ((dt*ubt(I,j) < BTCL_u(I,j)%uBT_EE) .and. (dt*uhbt(I,j) < BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_EE)) then
5425 ! Expand the cubic fit to use this new point. ubt is negative.
54260 BTCL_u(I,j)%ubt_EE = dt * ubt(I,j)
54270 if (3.0*uhbt(I,j) < 2.0*ubt(I,j) * BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_E0) then
5428 ! No further bounding is needed.
54290 BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_crvE = (uhbt(I,j) - ubt(I,j) * BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_E0) / (dt**2 * ubt(I,j)**3)
5430 else ! This should not happen often!
54310 BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_E0 = 1.5*uhbt(I,j) / ubt(I,j)
54320 BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_crvE = -0.5*uhbt(I,j) / (dt**2 * ubt(I,j)**3)
5433 endif
54340 BTCL_u(I,j)%uh_EE = dt * uhbt(I,j)
5435 ! I don't know whether this is helpful.
5436! BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_EE = min(BTCL_u(I,j)%FA_u_EE, uhbt(I,j) / ubt(I,j))
5437 endif
5438 enddo ; enddo
5439 !$OMP parallel do default(shared)
54400 do J=js-hs-1,je+hs ; do i=is-hs,ie+hs
54410 if ((dt*vbt(i,J) > BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_SS) .and. (dt*vhbt(i,J) > BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_SS)) then
5442 ! Expand the cubic fit to use this new point. vbt is negative.
54430 BTCL_v(i,J)%vbt_SS = dt * vbt(i,J)
54440 if (3.0*vhbt(i,J) < 2.0*vbt(i,J) * BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_S0) then
5445 ! No further bounding is needed.
54460 BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_crvS = (vhbt(i,J) - vbt(i,J) * BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_S0) / (dt**2 * vbt(i,J)**3)
5447 else ! This should not happen often!
54480 BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_S0 = 1.5*vhbt(i,J) / (vbt(i,J))
54490 BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_crvS = -0.5*vhbt(i,J) / (dt**2 * vbt(i,J)**3)
5450 endif
54510 BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_SS = dt * vhbt(i,J)
5452 ! I don't know whether this is helpful.
5453! BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_SS = min(BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_SS, vhbt(i,J) / vbt(i,J))
54540 elseif ((dt*vbt(i,J) < BTCL_v(i,J)%vBT_NN) .and. (dt*vhbt(i,J) < BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_NN)) then
5455 ! Expand the cubic fit to use this new point. vbt is negative.
54560 BTCL_v(i,J)%vbt_NN = dt * vbt(i,J)
54570 if (3.0*vhbt(i,J) < 2.0*vbt(i,J) * BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_N0) then
5458 ! No further bounding is needed.
54590 BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_crvN = (vhbt(i,J) - vbt(i,J) * BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_N0) / (dt**2 * vbt(i,J)**3)
5460 else ! This should not happen often!
54610 BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_N0 = 1.5*vhbt(i,J) / (vbt(i,J))
54620 BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_crvN = -0.5*vhbt(i,J) / (dt**2 * vbt(i,J)**3)
5463 endif
54640 BTCL_v(i,J)%vh_NN = dt * vhbt(i,J)
5465 ! I don't know whether this is helpful.
5466! BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_NN = min(BTCL_v(i,J)%FA_v_NN, vhbt(i,J) / vbt(i,J))
5467 endif
5468 enddo ; enddo
5469
54700end subroutine adjust_local_BT_cont_types
5471
5472!> This subroutine uses the BT_cont_type to find the maximum face
5473!! areas, which can then be used for finding wave speeds, etc.
54740subroutine BT_cont_to_face_areas(BT_cont, Datu, Datv, G, US, MS, halo)
5475 type(BT_cont_type), intent(inout) :: BT_cont !< The BT_cont_type input to the
5476 !! barotropic solver.
5477 type(memory_size_type), intent(in) :: MS !< A type that describes the memory
5478 !! sizes of the argument arrays.
5479 real, dimension(MS%isdw-1:MS%iedw,MS%jsdw:MS%jedw), &
5480 intent(out) :: Datu !< The effective zonal face area [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
5481 real, dimension(MS%isdw:MS%iedw,MS%jsdw-1:MS%jedw), &
5482 intent(out) :: Datv !< The effective meridional face area [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
5483 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
5484 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
5485 integer, optional, intent(in) :: halo !< The extra halo size to use here.
5486
5487 ! Local variables
5488 integer :: i, j, is, ie, js, je, hs
54890 is = G%isc ; ie = G%iec ; js = G%jsc ; je = G%jec
54900 hs = 1 ; if (present(halo)) hs = max(halo,0)
5491
54920 do concurrent (j=js-hs:je+hs, I=is-1-hs:ie+hs)
5493 Datu(I,j) = max(BT_cont%FA_u_EE(I,j), BT_cont%FA_u_E0(I,j), &
54940 BT_cont%FA_u_W0(I,j), BT_cont%FA_u_WW(I,j))
5495 enddo
54960 do concurrent (J=js-1-hs:je+hs, i=is-hs:ie+hs)
5497 Datv(i,J) = max(BT_cont%FA_v_NN(i,J), BT_cont%FA_v_N0(i,J), &
54980 BT_cont%FA_v_S0(i,J), BT_cont%FA_v_SS(i,J))
5499 enddo
5500
55010end subroutine BT_cont_to_face_areas
5502
5503!> Swap the values of two real variables
55040pure subroutine swap(a,b)
5505 real, intent(inout) :: a !< The first variable to be swapped [arbitrary units]
5506 real, intent(inout) :: b !< The second variable to be swapped [arbitrary units]
5507 real :: tmp ! A temporary variable [arbitrary units]
55080 tmp = a ; a = b ; b = tmp
55090end subroutine swap
5510
5511!> This subroutine determines the open face areas of cells for calculating
5512!! the barotropic transport.
55134subroutine find_face_areas(Datu, Datv, G, GV, US, CS, MS, halo, eta, add_max)
5514 type(memory_size_type), intent(in) :: MS !< A type that describes the memory sizes of the argument arrays.
5515 real, dimension(MS%isdw-1:MS%iedw,MS%jsdw:MS%jedw), &
5516 intent(out) :: Datu !< The open zonal face area [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
5517 real, dimension(MS%isdw:MS%iedw,MS%jsdw-1:MS%jedw), &
5518 intent(out) :: Datv !< The open meridional face area [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
5519 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
5520 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
5521 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
5522 type(barotropic_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
5523 integer, intent(in) :: halo !< The halo size to use, default = 1.
5524 real, dimension(MS%isdw:MS%iedw,MS%jsdw:MS%jedw), &
5525 optional, intent(in) :: eta !< The barotropic free surface height anomaly
5526 !! or column mass anomaly [H ~> m or kg m-2].
5527 real, optional, intent(in) :: add_max !< A value to add to the maximum depth (used
5528 !! to overestimate the external wave speed) [Z ~> m].
5529
5530 ! Local variables
5531 real :: H1, H2 ! Temporary total thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
5532 real :: Z_to_H ! A local conversion factor [H Z-1 ~> nondim or kg m-3]
5533 integer :: i, j, is, ie, js, je, hs
553415 is = G%isc ; ie = G%iec ; js = G%jsc ; je = G%jec
553515 hs = max(halo,0)
5536
553715 if (present(eta)) then
5538 ! The use of harmonic mean thicknesses ensure positive definiteness.
55394 if (GV%Boussinesq) then
55401448 do concurrent (j=js-hs:je+hs, I=is-1-hs:ie+hs)
5541259920 H1 = CS%bathyT(i,j)*GV%Z_to_H + eta(i,j) ; H2 = CS%bathyT(i+1,j)*GV%Z_to_H + eta(i+1,j)
5542259920 Datu(I,j) = 0.0 ; if ((H1 > 0.0) .and. (H2 > 0.0)) &
5543261368 Datu(I,j) = CS%dy_Cu(I,j) * (2.0 * H1 * H2) / (H1 + H2)
5544 ! Datu(I,j) = CS%dy_Cu(I,j) * 0.5 * (H1 + H2)
5545 enddo
5546
55471444 do concurrent (J=js-1-hs:je+hs, i=is-hs:ie+hs)
5548260640 H1 = CS%bathyT(i,j)*GV%Z_to_H + eta(i,j) ; H2 = CS%bathyT(i,j+1)*GV%Z_to_H + eta(i,j+1)
5549260640 Datv(i,J) = 0.0 ; if ((H1 > 0.0) .and. (H2 > 0.0)) &
5550262084 Datv(i,J) = CS%dx_Cv(i,J) * (2.0 * H1 * H2) / (H1 + H2)
5551 ! Datu(I,j) = CS%dy_Cu(I,j) * 0.5 * (H1 + H2)
5552 enddo
5553 else
55540 do concurrent (j=js-hs:je+hs, I=is-1-hs:ie+hs)
55550 Datu(I,j) = 0.0 ; if ((eta(i,j) > 0.0) .and. (eta(i+1,j) > 0.0)) &
5556 Datu(I,j) = CS%dy_Cu(I,j) * (2.0 * eta(i,j) * eta(i+1,j)) / &
55570 (eta(i,j) + eta(i+1,j))
5558 ! Datu(I,j) = CS%dy_Cu(I,j) * 0.5 * (eta(i,j) + eta(i+1,j))
5559 enddo
5560
55610 do concurrent (J=js-1-hs:je+hs, i=is-hs:ie+hs)
55620 Datv(i,J) = 0.0 ; if ((eta(i,j) > 0.0) .and. (eta(i,j+1) > 0.0)) &
5563 Datv(i,J) = CS%dx_Cv(i,J) * (2.0 * eta(i,j) * eta(i,j+1)) / &
55640 (eta(i,j) + eta(i,j+1))
5565 ! Datv(i,J) = CS%dy_v(i,J) * 0.5 * (eta(i,j) + eta(i,j+1))
5566 enddo
5567 endif
556815 elseif (present(add_max)) then
556914 Z_to_H = GV%Z_to_H ; if (.not.GV%Boussinesq) Z_to_H = GV%RZ_to_H * CS%Rho_BT_lin
5570
55711708 do concurrent (j=js-hs:je+hs, I=is-1-hs:ie+hs)
5572101640 H1 = max((G%meanSL(i+1,j) + add_max) + G%bathyT(i+1,j), 0.0)
5573101640 H2 = max((G%meanSL(i,j) + add_max) + G%bathyT(i,j), 0.0)
5574103348 Datu(I,j) = CS%dy_Cu(I,j) * Z_to_H * max(H1, H2)
5575 enddo
5576
55771694 do concurrent (J=js-1-hs:je+hs, i=is-hs:ie+hs)
5578102480 H1 = max((G%meanSL(i,j+1) + add_max) + G%bathyT(i,j+1), 0.0)
5579102480 H2 = max((G%meanSL(i,j) + add_max) + G%bathyT(i,j), 0.0)
5580104174 Datv(i,J) = CS%dx_Cv(i,J) * Z_to_H * max(H1, H2)
5581 enddo
5582 else
55831 Z_to_H = GV%Z_to_H ; if (.not.GV%Boussinesq) Z_to_H = GV%RZ_to_H * CS%Rho_BT_lin
5584
5585364 do concurrent (j=js-hs:je+hs, I=is-1-hs:ie+hs)
558666066 H1 = max(G%meanSL(i,j) + G%bathyT(i,j), 0.0) * Z_to_H
558766066 H2 = max(G%meanSL(i+1,j) + G%bathyT(i+1,j), 0.0) * Z_to_H
558866066 Datu(I,j) = 0.0
558966066 if ((H1 > 0.0) .and. (H2 > 0.0)) &
559066430 Datu(I,j) = CS%dy_Cu(I,j) * (2.0 * H1 * H2) / (H1 + H2)
5591 enddo
5592
5593363 do concurrent (J=js-1-hs:je+hs, i=is-hs:ie+hs)
559466246 H1 = max(G%meanSL(i,j) + G%bathyT(i,j), 0.0) * Z_to_H
559566246 H2 = max(G%meanSL(i,j+1) + G%bathyT(i,j+1), 0.0) * Z_to_H
559666246 Datv(i,J) = 0.0
559766246 if ((H1 > 0.0) .and. (H2 > 0.0)) &
559866609 Datv(i,J) = CS%dx_Cv(i,J) * (2.0 * H1 * H2) / (H1 + H2)
5599 enddo
5600 endif
560115end subroutine find_face_areas
5602
5603!> bt_mass_source determines the appropriately limited mass source for
5604!! the barotropic solver, along with a corrective fictitious mass source that
5605!! will drive the barotropic estimate of the free surface height toward the
5606!! baroclinic estimate.
56071440subroutine bt_mass_source(h, eta, set_cor, G, GV, CS)
5608 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
5609 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
5610 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: h !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
5611 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G)), intent(in) :: eta !< The free surface height that is to be
5612 !! corrected [H ~> m or kg m-2].
5613 logical, intent(in) :: set_cor !< A flag to indicate whether to set the corrective
5614 !! fluxes (and update the slowly varying part of eta_cor)
5615 !! (.true.) or whether to incrementally update the
5616 !! corrective fluxes.
5617 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
5618
5619 ! Local variables
56201440 real :: eta_h(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G)) ! The free surface height determined from
5621 ! the sum of the layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
5622 real :: d_eta ! The difference between estimates of the total
5623 ! thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
5624 integer :: is, ie, js, je, nz, i, j, k
5625
56261440 if (.not.CS%module_is_initialized) call MOM_error(FATAL, "bt_mass_source: "// &
56270 "Module MOM_barotropic must be initialized before it is used.")
5628
56291440 if (.not.CS%split) return
5630
56311440 is = G%isc ; ie = G%iec ; js = G%jsc ; je = G%jec ; nz = GV%ke
5632
5633 !$omp target data map(alloc: eta_h)
5634
56351440 do concurrent (j=js:je)
563657600 if (GV%Boussinesq) then
563757600 do concurrent (i=is:ie)
56382592000 eta_h(i,j) = h(i,j,1) - G%bathyT(i,j)*GV%Z_to_H
5639 enddo
5640 else
56410 do concurrent (i=is:ie)
56420 eta_h(i,j) = h(i,j,1)
5643 enddo
5644 endif
5645216000 do k=2,nz
564657600 do concurrent (i=is:ie)
564725787520 eta_h(i,j) = eta_h(i,j) + h(i,j,k)
5648 enddo
5649 enddo
5650116640 if (set_cor) then
565128800 do concurrent (i=is:ie)
56521267200 d_eta = eta_h(i,j) - eta(i,j)
56531296000 CS%eta_cor(i,j) = d_eta
5654 enddo
5655 else
565628800 do concurrent (i=is:ie)
56571267200 d_eta = eta_h(i,j) - eta(i,j)
56581296000 CS%eta_cor(i,j) = CS%eta_cor(i,j) + d_eta
5659 enddo
5660 endif
5661 enddo
5662
5663 !$omp end target data
5664
5665end subroutine bt_mass_source
5666
5667!> barotropic_init initializes a number of time-invariant fields used in the
5668!! barotropic calculation and initializes any barotropic fields that have not
5669!! already been initialized.
56701subroutine barotropic_init(u, v, h, Time, G, GV, US, param_file, diag, CS, &
5671 restart_CS, calc_dtbt, BT_cont, OBC, SAL_CSp, HA_CSp)
5672 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
5673 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
5674 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
5675 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
5676 intent(in) :: u !< The zonal velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
5677 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
5678 intent(in) :: v !< The meridional velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
5679 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
5680 intent(in) :: h !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
5681 type(time_type), target, intent(in) :: Time !< The current model time.
5682 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< A structure to parse for run-time parameters.
5683 type(diag_ctrl), target, intent(inout) :: diag !< A structure that is used to regulate diagnostic
5684 !! output.
5685 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
5686 type(MOM_restart_CS), intent(in) :: restart_CS !< MOM restart control structure
5687 logical, intent(out) :: calc_dtbt !< If true, the barotropic time step must
5688 !! be recalculated before stepping.
5689 type(BT_cont_type), pointer :: BT_cont !< A structure with elements that describe the
5690 !! effective open face areas as a function of
5691 !! barotropic flow.
5692 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< The open boundary condition structure.
5693 type(SAL_CS), target, optional :: SAL_CSp !< A pointer to the control structure of the
5694 !! SAL module.
5695 type(harmonic_analysis_CS), target, optional :: HA_CSp !< A pointer to the control structure of the
5696 !! harmonic analysis module
5697
5698 ! This include declares and sets the variable "version".
5699# include "version_variable.h"
5700 ! Local variables
5701 character(len=40) :: mdl = "MOM_barotropic" ! This module's name.
57021 real :: Datu(SZIBS_(G),SZJ_(G)) ! Zonal open face area [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
57031 real :: Datv(SZI_(G),SZJBS_(G)) ! Meridional open face area [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
5704 real :: gtot_estimate ! Summed GV%g_prime [L2 H-1 T-2 ~> m s-2 or m4 kg-1 s-2], to give an
5705 ! upper-bound estimate for pbce.
5706 real :: SSH_extra ! An estimate of how much higher SSH might get, for use
5707 ! in calculating the safe external wave speed [Z ~> m].
5708 real :: dtbt_input ! The input value of DTBT, [nondim] if negative or [s] if positive.
5709 real :: dtbt_restart ! A temporary copy of CS%dtbt read from a restart file [T ~> s]
5710 real :: wave_drag_scale ! A scaling factor for the barotropic linear wave drag
5711 ! piston velocities [nondim].
5712 character(len=200) :: inputdir ! The directory in which to find input files.
5713 character(len=200) :: wave_drag_file ! The file from which to read the wave
5714 ! drag piston velocity.
5715 character(len=80) :: wave_drag_var ! The wave drag piston velocity variable
5716 ! name in wave_drag_file.
5717 character(len=80) :: wave_drag_u ! The wave drag piston velocity variable
5718 ! name in wave_drag_file.
5719 character(len=80) :: wave_drag_v ! The wave drag piston velocity variable
5720 ! name in wave_drag_file.
5721 real :: htot ! Total column thickness used when BT_NONLIN_STRESS is false [Z ~> m].
5722 real :: Z_to_H ! A local unit conversion factor [H Z-1 ~> nondim or kg m-3]
5723 real :: H_to_Z ! A local unit conversion factor [Z H-1 ~> nondim or m3 kg-1]
5724 real :: det_de ! The partial derivative due to self-attraction and loading of the reference
5725 ! geopotential with the sea surface height when scalar SAL are enabled [nondim].
5726 ! This is typically ~0.09 or less.
5727 real :: h_a_neglect ! A cell volume or mass that is so small it is usually lost
5728 ! in roundoff and can be neglected [H L2 ~> m3 or kg]
57291 real, allocatable :: lin_drag_h(:,:) ! A spatially varying linear drag coefficient at tracer points
5730 ! that acts on the barotropic flow [H T-1 ~> m s-1 or kg m-2 s-1].
5731
5732 type(memory_size_type) :: MS
5733 type(group_pass_type) :: pass_static_data, pass_q_D_Cor
5734 type(group_pass_type) :: pass_bt_hbt_btav, pass_a_polarity
5735 integer :: default_answer_date ! The default setting for the various ANSWER_DATE flags.
5736 logical :: use_BT_cont_type
5737 logical :: mask_coastal_pressure_force ! If true, apply masks to some stored inverse grid spacings
5738 ! so that diagnosed barotropic pressure gradient forces are zero at
5739 ! land, coastal or OBC points.
5740 logical :: use_tides
5741 logical :: OBC_projection_bug
5742 logical :: enable_bugs ! If true, the defaults for recently added bug-fix flags are set to
5743 ! recreate the bugs, or if false bugs are only used if actively selected.
5744 logical :: visc_rem_bug ! Stores the value of runtime paramter VISC_REM_BUG.
5745 logical :: dtbt_restart_bug ! Stores the value of runtime parameter DTBT_RESTART_BUG.
5746 character(len=48) :: thickness_units, flux_units
5747 character*(40) :: hvel_str
5748 integer :: is, ie, js, je, Isq, Ieq, Jsq, Jeq, nz
5749 integer :: isd, ied, jsd, jed, IsdB, IedB, JsdB, JedB
5750 integer :: isdw, iedw, jsdw, jedw
5751 integer :: i, j, k
5752 integer :: wd_halos(2), bt_halo_sz
57531 isd = G%isd ; ied = G%ied ; jsd = G%jsd ; jed = G%jed
57541 IsdB = G%IsdB ; IedB = G%IedB ; JsdB = G%JsdB ; JedB = G%JedB
57551 is = G%isc ; ie = G%iec ; js = G%jsc ; je = G%jec ; nz = GV%ke
57561 Isq = G%IscB ; Ieq = G%IecB ; Jsq = G%JscB ; Jeq = G%JecB
57571 MS%isdw = G%isd ; MS%iedw = G%ied ; MS%jsdw = G%jsd ; MS%jedw = G%jed
5758
57591 if (CS%module_is_initialized) then
5760 call MOM_error(WARNING, "barotropic_init called with a control structure "// &
57610 "that has already been initialized.")
57620 return
5763 endif
57641 CS%module_is_initialized = .true.
5765
57661 CS%diag => diag ; CS%Time => Time
57671 if (present(SAL_CSp)) then
57681 CS%SAL_CSp => SAL_CSp
5769 endif
5770
5771 ! Read all relevant parameters and write them to the model log.
57721 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "SPLIT", CS%split, default=.true., do_not_log=.true.)
5773 call log_version(param_file, mdl, version, "", log_to_all=.true., layout=CS%split, &
57741 debugging=CS%split, all_default=.not.CS%split)
5775 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "SPLIT", CS%split, &
57761 "Use the split time stepping if true.", default=.true.)
57771 if (.not.CS%split) return
5778
5779 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "USE_BT_CONT_TYPE", use_BT_cont_type, &
5780 "If true, use a structure with elements that describe "//&
5781 "effective face areas from the summed continuity solver "//&
5782 "as a function the barotropic flow in coupling between "//&
5783 "the barotropic and baroclinic flow. This is only used "//&
57841 "if SPLIT is true.", default=.true.)
5785 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "INTEGRAL_BT_CONTINUITY", CS%integral_bt_cont, &
5786 "If true, use the time-integrated velocity over the barotropic steps "//&
5787 "to determine the integrated transports used to update the continuity "//&
5788 "equation. Otherwise the transports are the sum of the transports based on "//&
5789 "a series of instantaneous velocities and the BT_CONT_TYPE for transports. "//&
5790 "This is only valid if USE_BT_CONT_TYPE = True.", &
57911 default=.false., do_not_log=.not.use_BT_cont_type)
5792 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "BOUND_BT_CORRECTION", CS%bound_BT_corr, &
5793 "If true, the corrective pseudo mass-fluxes into the "//&
5794 "barotropic solver are limited to values that require "//&
57951 "less than maxCFL_BT_cont to be accommodated.",default=.false.)
5796 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "BT_CONT_CORR_BOUNDS", CS%BT_cont_bounds, &
5797 "If true, and BOUND_BT_CORRECTION is true, use the "//&
5798 "BT_cont_type variables to set limits determined by "//&
5799 "MAXCFL_BT_CONT on the CFL number of the velocities "//&
5800 "that are likely to be driven by the corrective mass fluxes.", &
58011 default=.true., do_not_log=.not.CS%bound_BT_corr)
5802 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "ADJUST_BT_CONT", CS%adjust_BT_cont, &
5803 "If true, adjust the curve fit to the BT_cont type "//&
5804 "that is used by the barotropic solver to match the "//&
5805 "transport about which the flow is being linearized.", &
58061 default=.false., do_not_log=.not.use_BT_cont_type)
5807 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "GRADUAL_BT_ICS", CS%gradual_BT_ICs, &
5808 "If true, adjust the initial conditions for the "//&
5809 "barotropic solver to the values from the layered "//&
5810 "solution over a whole timestep instead of instantly. "//&
5811 "This is a decent approximation to the inclusion of "//&
5812 "sum(u dh_dt) while also correcting for truncation errors.", &
58131 default=.false.)
5814 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "BT_ADJUST_SRC_FOR_FILTER", CS%bt_adjust_src_for_filter, &
5815 "If true, increases the rate at which BT mass sources are applied so "//&
5816 "that they are all used up before the filtering period starts. "//&
5817 "This option is only valid if INTEGRAL_BT_CONTINUITY = True.", &
58181 default=.false., do_not_log=.not.CS%integral_bt_cont)
5819 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "BT_LIMIT_INTEGRAL_TRANSPORT", CS%bt_limit_integral_transport, &
5820 "If true, limit the time-integrated transports by the initial volume "//&
5821 "accounting for sinks of mass. The limiter uses MAXCFL_BT_CONT. "//&
5822 "This option is only valid if INTEGRAL_BT_CONTINUITY = True.", &
58231 default=.false., do_not_log=.not.CS%integral_bt_cont)
5824 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "BT_USE_VISC_REM_U_UH0", CS%visc_rem_u_uh0, &
5825 "If true, use the viscous remnants when estimating the "//&
5826 "barotropic velocities that were used to calculate uh0 "//&
58271 "and vh0. False is probably the better choice.", default=.false.)
5828 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "BT_USE_WIDE_HALOS", CS%use_wide_halos, &
5829 "If true, use wide halos and march in during the "//&
5830 "barotropic time stepping for efficiency.", default=.true., &
58311 layoutParam=.true.)
5832 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "BTHALO", bt_halo_sz, &
5833 "The minimum halo size for the barotropic solver.", default=0, &
58341 layoutParam=.true.)
5835 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "BT_WIDE_HALO_MIN_STENCIL", CS%min_stencil, &
5836 "The minimum stencil width to use with the wide halo iterations. "//&
5837 "A nonzero value may be useful for debugging purposes, but at the "//&
5838 "cost of reducing the efficiency gain from BT_USE_WIDE_HALOS.", &
58391 default=0, layoutParam=.true., do_not_log=.not.CS%use_wide_halos)
5840#ifdef STATIC_MEMORY_
5841 if ((bt_halo_sz > 0) .and. (bt_halo_sz /= BTHALO_)) call MOM_error(FATAL, &
5842 "barotropic_init: Run-time values of BTHALO must agree with the "//&
5843 "macro BTHALO_ with STATIC_MEMORY_.")
5844 wd_halos(1) = WHALOI_+NIHALO_ ; wd_halos(2) = WHALOJ_+NJHALO_
5845#else
58461 wd_halos(1) = bt_halo_sz ; wd_halos(2) = bt_halo_sz
5847#endif
5848 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "NONLINEAR_BT_CONTINUITY", CS%Nonlinear_continuity, &
5849 "If true, use nonlinear transports in the barotropic "//&
5850 "continuity equation. This does not apply if "//&
58511 "USE_BT_CONT_TYPE is true.", default=.false., do_not_log=use_BT_cont_type)
5852 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "NONLIN_BT_CONT_UPDATE_PERIOD", CS%Nonlin_cont_update_period, &
5853 "If NONLINEAR_BT_CONTINUITY is true, this is the number "//&
5854 "of barotropic time steps between updates to the face "//&
5855 "areas, or 0 to update only before the barotropic stepping.", &
58561 default=1, do_not_log=.not.CS%Nonlinear_continuity)
5857
5858 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "BT_PROJECT_VELOCITY", CS%BT_project_velocity,&
5859 "If true, step the barotropic velocity first and project "//&
5860 "out the velocity tendency by 1+BEBT when calculating the "//&
5861 "transport. The default (false) is to use a predictor "//&
5862 "continuity step to find the pressure field, and then "//&
5863 "to do a corrector continuity step using a weighted "//&
5864 "average of the old and new velocities, with weights "//&
58651 "of (1-BEBT) and BEBT.", default=.false.)
5866 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "BT_NONLIN_STRESS", CS%nonlin_stress, &
5867 "If true, use the full depth of the ocean at the start of the barotropic "//&
5868 "step when calculating the surface stress contribution to the barotropic "//&
58691 "acclerations. Otherwise use the depth based on bathyT.", default=.false.)
5870 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "BT_RHO_LINEARIZED", CS%Rho_BT_lin, &
5871 "A density that is used to convert total water column thicknesses into mass "//&
5872 "in non-Boussinesq mode with linearized options in the barotropic solver or "//&
5873 "when estimating the stable barotropic timestep without access to the full "//&
5874 "baroclinic model state.", &
5875 units="kg m-3", default=GV%Rho0*US%R_to_kg_m3, scale=US%kg_m3_to_R, &
58761 do_not_log=GV%Boussinesq)

62280 do j=jsd,jed ; do i=isd,ied
62290 if (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I-1,j) > 0) CS%IareaT_OBCmask(i,j) = 0.0 ! OBC_DIRECTION_E
62300 if (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) < 0) CS%IareaT_OBCmask(i,j) = 0.0 ! OBC_DIRECTION_W
6231 enddo ; enddo
6232 endif
62330 if (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE) then
62340 do j=jsd,jed ; do i=isd,ied
62350 if (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J-1) > 0) CS%IareaT_OBCmask(i,j) = 0.0 ! OBC_DIRECTION_N
62360 if (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) < 0) CS%IareaT_OBCmask(i,j) = 0.0 ! OBC_DIRECTION_S
6237 enddo ; enddo
6238 endif
6239 endif

62430 do j=G%jsd,G%jed ; do I=G%IsdB,G%IedB ; if (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) /= 0) then
62440 CS%OBCmask_u(I,j) = 0.0 ; CS%IdxCu(I,j) = 0.0
6245 endif ; enddo ; enddo
6246 endif
62470 if (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE) then
62480 do J=G%JsdB,G%JedB ; do i=G%isd,G%ied ; if (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) /= 0) then
62490 CS%OBCmask_v(i,J) = 0.0 ; CS%IdyCv(i,J) = 0.0
6250 endif ; enddo ; enddo
6251 endif

62621 call create_group_pass(pass_static_data, CS%IareaT_OBCmask, CS%BT_domain, To_All)
62631 call create_group_pass(pass_static_data, CS%IdxCu, CS%IdyCv, CS%BT_domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
62641 call create_group_pass(pass_static_data, CS%dy_Cu, CS%dx_Cv, CS%BT_domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)

62661 call do_group_pass(pass_static_data, CS%BT_domain)
6267
6268 ! Determine the weights to use for the thicknesses when calculating PV for use in the Coriolis terms
6269348895 allocate(CS%q_wt(4,CS%isdw-1:CS%iedw,CS%jsdw-1:CS%jedw), source=0.0)
627065523 do J=js-1,je ; do I=is-1,ie
627165522 if (G%mask2dT(i,j) + G%mask2dT(i,j+1) + G%mask2dT(i+1,j) + G%mask2dT(i+1,j+1) > 0.) then
627246914 CS%q_wt(1,I,J) = G%areaT(i,j) ; CS%q_wt(2,I,J) = G%areaT(i+1,j)
627346914 CS%q_wt(3,I,J) = G%areaT(i,j+1) ; CS%q_wt(4,I,J) = G%areaT(i+1,j+1)
6274 else
627592135 CS%q_wt(1:4,I,J) = 0.0
6276 endif
6277 enddo ; enddo
6278
62791 if (CS%interior_OBC_PV .and. (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBCs_on_PE .or. CS%BT_OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE)) then
6280 ! Reset the potential vorticity at OBC vertices as a masked weighted average.
62810 do J=js-1,je ; do I=is-1,ie
62820 if ((G%mask2dT(i,j) + G%mask2dT(i,j+1) + G%mask2dT(i+1,j) + G%mask2dT(i+1,j+1) > 0.) .and. &
6283 ((abs(CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j)) > 0) .or. (abs(CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j+1)) > 0) .or. &
62840 (abs(CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J)) > 0) .or. (abs(CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i+1,J)) > 0)) ) then
6285 ! This is an OBC vertex, so use an area weighted masked average and avoid external values.
62860 CS%q_wt(1,I,J) = G%mask2dT(i,j) * G%areaT(i,j)
62870 CS%q_wt(2,I,J) = G%mask2dT(i+1,j) * G%areaT(i+1,j)
62880 CS%q_wt(3,I,J) = G%mask2dT(i,j+1) * G%areaT(i,j+1)
62890 CS%q_wt(4,I,J) = G%mask2dT(i+1,j+1) * G%areaT(i+1,j+1)
6290
6291 ! The following block is the equivalent of shifting weights inward across OBC points. With
6292 ! two OBCs in a line, it gives weights of about 1/2 and 1/2 to the interior points. At a
6293 ! peninsula-like corner between two OBCs it gives weights of about 3/8, 1/4 and 3/8 for the
6294 ! 3 interior points. At a bay-liek corner there is only one interior point with a weight of 1.
6295 ! The masking above zeros out the weights for exterior points.
62960 if (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) > 0) then ! Eastern OBC in the u-point to the south
62970 CS%q_wt(1,I,J) = CS%q_wt(1,I,J) + 0.5*G%mask2dT(i,j)*G%areaT(i,j) ! already CS%q_wt(2,I,J) = 0.0
62980 elseif (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) < 0) then ! Western OBC in the u-point to the south
62990 CS%q_wt(2,I,J) = CS%q_wt(2,I,J) + 0.5*G%mask2dT(i+1,j)*G%areaT(i+1,j) ! already CS%q_wt(1,I,J) = 0.0
6300 endif
63010 if (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j+1) > 0) then ! Eastern OBC in the u-point to the north
63020 CS%q_wt(3,I,J) = CS%q_wt(3,I,J) + 0.5*G%mask2dT(i,j+1)*G%areaT(i,j+1) ! already CS%q_wt(4,I,J) = 0.0
63030 elseif (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j+1) < 0) then ! Western OBC in the u-point to the north
63040 CS%q_wt(4,I,J) = CS%q_wt(4,I,J) + 0.5*G%mask2dT(i+1,j+1)*G%areaT(i+1,j+1) ! already CS%q_wt(3,I,J) = 0.0
6305 endif
63060 if (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) > 0) then ! Northern OBC in the v-point to the west
63070 CS%q_wt(1,I,J) = CS%q_wt(1,I,J) + 0.5*G%mask2dT(i,j)*G%areaT(i,j) ! already CS%q_wt(3,I,J) = 0.0
63080 elseif (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) < 0) then ! Southern OBC in the v-point to the west
63090 CS%q_wt(3,I,J) = CS%q_wt(3,I,J) + 0.5*G%mask2dT(i,j+1)*G%areaT(i,j+1) ! already CS%q_wt(1,I,J) = 0.0
6310 endif
63110 if (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i+1,J) > 0) then ! Northern OBC in the v-point to the west
63120 CS%q_wt(2,I,J) = CS%q_wt(2,I,J) + 0.5*G%mask2dT(i+1,j)*G%areaT(i+1,j) ! already CS%q_wt(4,I,J) = 0.0
63130 elseif (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i+1,J) < 0) then ! Southern OBC in the v-point to the west
63140 CS%q_wt(4,I,J) = CS%q_wt(4,I,J) + 0.5*G%mask2dT(i+1,j+1)*G%areaT(i+1,j+1) ! already CS%q_wt(2,I,J) = 0.0
6315 endif
6316 endif
6317 enddo ; enddo
6318 endif
6319
63201 if (CS%linearized_BT_PV) then
632169931 allocate(CS%q_D(CS%isdw-1:CS%iedw,CS%jsdw-1:CS%jedw), source=0.0)
632269561 allocate(CS%D_u_Cor(CS%isdw-1:CS%iedw,CS%jsdw:CS%jedw), source=0.0)
632369742 allocate(CS%D_v_Cor(CS%isdw:CS%iedw,CS%jsdw-1:CS%jedw), source=0.0)
6324
63251 Z_to_H = GV%Z_to_H ; if (.not.GV%Boussinesq) Z_to_H = GV%RZ_to_H * CS%Rho_BT_lin
6326
632765161 do j=js,je ; do I=is-1,ie
6328 CS%D_u_Cor(I,j) = 0.5 * ( max(G%meanSL(i+1,j) + G%bathyT(i+1,j), 0.0) &
632965160 + max(G%meanSL(i,j) + G%bathyT(i,j), 0.0) ) * Z_to_H
6330 enddo ; enddo
63311 if (CS%interior_OBC_PV .and. CS%BT_OBC%u_OBCs_on_PE) then ; do j=js,je ; do I=is-1,ie
63320 if (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) < 0) & ! Western boundary condition
63330 CS%D_u_Cor(I,j) = max(G%meanSL(i+1,j) + G%bathyT(i+1,j), 0.0) * Z_to_H
63340 if (CS%BT_OBC%u_OBC_type(I,j) > 0) & ! Eastern boundary condition
63350 CS%D_u_Cor(I,j) = max(G%meanSL(i,j) + G%bathyT(i,j), 0.0) * Z_to_H
6336 enddo ; enddo ; endif
6337
633865342 do J=js-1,je ; do i=is,ie
6339 CS%D_v_Cor(i,J) = 0.5 * ( max(G%meanSL(i,j+1) + G%bathyT(i,j+1), 0.0) &
634065341 + max(G%meanSL(i,j) + G%bathyT(i,j), 0.0) ) * Z_to_H
6341 enddo ; enddo
63421 if (CS%interior_OBC_PV .and. CS%BT_OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE) then ; do J=js-1,je ; do i=is,ie
63430 if (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) < 0) & ! Southern boundary condition
63440 CS%D_v_Cor(i,J) = max(G%meanSL(i,j+1) + G%bathyT(i,j+1), 0.0) * Z_to_H
63450 if (CS%BT_OBC%v_OBC_type(i,J) > 0) & ! Northern boundary condition
63460 CS%D_v_Cor(i,J) = max(G%meanSL(i,j) + G%bathyT(i,j), 0.0) * Z_to_H
6347 enddo ; enddo ; endif
6348
63491 h_a_neglect = GV%H_subroundoff * 1.0 * US%m_to_L**2
635065523 do J=js-1,je ; do I=is-1,ie
635165522 if ((CS%q_wt(1,I,J) + CS%q_wt(4,I,J)) + (CS%q_wt(2,I,J) + CS%q_wt(3,I,J)) > 0.) then
6352 CS%q_D(I,J) = 0.25 * (CS%BT_Coriolis_scale * G%CoriolisBu(I,J)) * &
6353 ((CS%q_wt(1,I,J) + CS%q_wt(4,I,J)) + (CS%q_wt(2,I,J) + CS%q_wt(3,I,J))) / &
6354 max(Z_to_H * (((CS%q_wt(1,I,J) * max(G%meanSL(i,j) + G%bathyT(i,j), 0.0)) + &
6355 (CS%q_wt(4,I,J) * max(G%meanSL(i+1,j+1) + G%bathyT(i+1,j+1), 0.0))) + &
6356 ((CS%q_wt(2,I,J) * max(G%meanSL(i+1,j) + G%bathyT(i+1,j), 0.0)) + &
6357 (CS%q_wt(3,I,J) * max(G%meanSL(i,j+1) + G%bathyT(i,j+1), 0.0)))), &
635846914 h_a_neglect)
6359 else ! All four h points are masked out so q_D(I,J) is meaningless
636018427 CS%q_D(I,J) = 0.
6361 endif
6362 enddo ; enddo

6518 CS%id_uhbt_hifreq = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'uhbt_hifreq', diag%axesCu1, Time, &

65201 'm3 s-1', conversion=GV%H_to_m*US%L_to_m*US%L_T_to_m_s)

6524 CS%id_frhatu = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'frhatu', diag%axesCuL, Time, &

6530 CS%id_frhatv1 = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'frhatv1', diag%axesCvL, Time, &

6535 CS%id_vhbt = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'vhbt', diag%axesCv1, Time, &

65371 'm3 s-1', conversion=GV%H_to_m*US%L_to_m*US%L_T_to_m_s)
6538
65391 if (use_BT_cont_type) then
6540 CS%id_BTC_FA_u_EE = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_FA_u_EE', diag%axesCu1, Time, &
65411 'BTCont type far east face area', 'm2', conversion=US%L_to_m*GV%H_to_m)
6542 CS%id_BTC_FA_u_E0 = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_FA_u_E0', diag%axesCu1, Time, &
65431 'BTCont type near east face area', 'm2', conversion=US%L_to_m*GV%H_to_m)
6544 CS%id_BTC_FA_u_WW = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_FA_u_WW', diag%axesCu1, Time, &
65451 'BTCont type far west face area', 'm2', conversion=US%L_to_m*GV%H_to_m)
6546 CS%id_BTC_FA_u_W0 = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_FA_u_W0', diag%axesCu1, Time, &
65471 'BTCont type near west face area', 'm2', conversion=US%L_to_m*GV%H_to_m)
6548 CS%id_BTC_ubt_EE = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_ubt_EE', diag%axesCu1, Time, &
65491 'BTCont type far east velocity', 'm s-1', conversion=US%L_T_to_m_s)
6550 CS%id_BTC_ubt_WW = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_ubt_WW', diag%axesCu1, Time, &
65511 'BTCont type far west velocity', 'm s-1', conversion=US%L_T_to_m_s)
6552 ! This is a specialized diagnostic that is not being made widely available (yet).
6553 ! CS%id_BTC_FA_u_rat0 = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_FA_u_rat0', diag%axesCu1, Time, &
6554 ! 'BTCont type ratio of near east and west face areas', 'nondim')
6555 CS%id_BTC_FA_v_NN = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_FA_v_NN', diag%axesCv1, Time, &
65561 'BTCont type far north face area', 'm2', conversion=US%L_to_m*GV%H_to_m)
6557 CS%id_BTC_FA_v_N0 = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_FA_v_N0', diag%axesCv1, Time, &
65581 'BTCont type near north face area', 'm2', conversion=US%L_to_m*GV%H_to_m)
6559 CS%id_BTC_FA_v_SS = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_FA_v_SS', diag%axesCv1, Time, &
65601 'BTCont type far south face area', 'm2', conversion=US%L_to_m*GV%H_to_m)
6561 CS%id_BTC_FA_v_S0 = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_FA_v_S0', diag%axesCv1, Time, &
65621 'BTCont type near south face area', 'm2', conversion=US%L_to_m*GV%H_to_m)
6563 CS%id_BTC_vbt_NN = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_vbt_NN', diag%axesCv1, Time, &
65641 'BTCont type far north velocity', 'm s-1', conversion=US%L_T_to_m_s)
6565 CS%id_BTC_vbt_SS = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_vbt_SS', diag%axesCv1, Time, &
65661 'BTCont type far south velocity', 'm s-1', conversion=US%L_T_to_m_s)
6567 ! This is a specialized diagnostic that is not being made widely available (yet).

6570 ! CS%id_BTC_FA_h_rat0 = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'BTC_FA_h_rat0', diag%axesT1, Time, &
6571 ! 'BTCont type maximum ratios of near face areas around cells', 'nondim')

6575 CS%id_vhbt0 = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'vhbt0', diag%axesCv1, Time, &
65761 'Barotropic meridional transport difference', 'm3 s-1', conversion=GV%H_to_m*US%L_to_m**2*US%s_to_T)
65771 if (associated(OBC)) then
65780 if (OBC%Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. OBC%Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally) then
6579 CS%id_SSH_u_OBC = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'SSH_u_OBC', diag%axesCu1, Time, &
65800 'Outer sea surface height at u OBC points', 'm', conversion=US%Z_to_m)
6581 CS%id_SSH_v_OBC = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'SSH_v_OBC', diag%axesCv1, Time, &
65820 'Outer sea surface height at v OBC points', 'm', conversion=US%Z_to_m)
6583 CS%id_ubt_OBC = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'ubt_OBC', diag%axesCu1, Time, &

6585 CS%id_vbt_OBC = register_diag_field('ocean_model', 'vbt_OBC', diag%axesCv1, Time, &
65860 'Outer v velocity at OBC points', 'm', conversion=US%L_T_to_m_s)

6590 !$omp target update to (CS)
6591
6592 ! CS%dtbt calculated here by set_dtbt is only used when dtbt is not reset during the run, i.e. DTBT_RESET_PERIOD<0.
6593 !$omp target enter data map (to: CS%frhatu, CS%frhatv)
6594 !$omp target enter data map (to: CS%eta_cor)
65951 call set_dtbt(G, GV, US, CS, gtot_est=gtot_estimate, SSH_add=SSH_extra)
6596
65971 if (dtbt_input > 0.0) then
65980 CS%dtbt = US%s_to_T * dtbt_input
65991 elseif (dtbt_restart > 0.0) then
66000 CS%dtbt = dtbt_restart
6601 endif
6602 !$omp target update to (CS%dtbt)
6603
66041 if (dtbt_restart_bug) then
66051 calc_dtbt = .true. ; if ((dtbt_restart > 0.0) .and. (dtbt_input > 0.0)) calc_dtbt = .false.
6606 else
66070 calc_dtbt = (dtbt_restart <= 0.0)
6608 endif
6609
6610
66111 call log_param(param_file, mdl, "DTBT as used", CS%dtbt, units="s", unscale=US%T_to_s)
66121 call log_param(param_file, mdl, "estimated maximum DTBT", CS%dtbt_max, units="s", unscale=US%T_to_s)
6613
66141 if (CS%id_frhatu1 > 0) allocate(CS%frhatu1(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,nz), source=0.)
66151 if (CS%id_frhatv1 > 0) allocate(CS%frhatv1(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,nz), source=0.)
6616
66171 if (.NOT.query_initialized(CS%ubtav,"ubtav",restart_CS) .or. &
6618 .NOT.query_initialized(CS%vbtav,"vbtav",restart_CS)) then
6619 !$omp target update to(h)
66201 call btcalc(h, G, GV, CS, may_use_default=.true.)
6621139302 CS%ubtav(:,:) = 0.0 ; CS%vbtav(:,:) = 0.0
66221433543 do k=1,nz ; do j=js,je ; do I=is-1,ie
66231433520 CS%ubtav(I,j) = CS%ubtav(I,j) + CS%frhatu(I,j,k) * u(I,j,k)
6624 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
66251437525 do k=1,nz ; do J=js-1,je ; do i=is,ie
66261437502 CS%vbtav(i,J) = CS%vbtav(i,J) + CS%frhatv(i,J,k) * v(i,J,k)
6627 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
6628 endif
6629
66301 if (CS%gradual_BT_ICs) then
66310 if (.NOT.query_initialized(CS%ubt_IC,"ubt_IC",restart_CS) .or. &
6632 .NOT.query_initialized(CS%vbt_IC,"vbt_IC",restart_CS)) then
66330 do j=js,je ; do I=is-1,ie ; CS%ubt_IC(I,j) = CS%ubtav(I,j) ; enddo ; enddo
66340 do J=js-1,je ; do i=is,ie ; CS%vbt_IC(i,J) = CS%vbtav(i,J) ; enddo ; enddo
6635 endif
6636 endif
6637 ! Calculate other constants which are used for btstep.
6638
66391 if (.not.CS%nonlin_stress) then
66401 Z_to_H = GV%Z_to_H ; if (.not.GV%Boussinesq) Z_to_H = GV%RZ_to_H * CS%Rho_BT_lin
664165161 do j=js,je ; do I=is-1,ie
664264980 htot = max(G%meanSL(i+1,j) + G%bathyT(i+1,j), 0.0) + max(G%meanSL(i,j) + G%bathyT(i,j), 0.0)
664365160 if (G%OBCmaskCu(I,j) * htot > 0.) then
664446067 CS%IDatu(I,j) = G%OBCmaskCu(I,j) * 2.0 / (Z_to_H * htot)
6645 else ! Both neighboring H points are masked out or this is an OBC face so IDatu(I,j) is unused
664618913 CS%IDatu(I,j) = 0.
6647 endif
6648 enddo ; enddo
664965342 do J=js-1,je ; do i=is,ie
665065160 htot = max(G%meanSL(i,j+1) + G%bathyT(i,j+1), 0.0) + max(G%meanSL(i,j) + G%bathyT(i,j), 0.0)
665165341 if (G%OBCmaskCv(i,J) * htot > 0.) then
665245890 CS%IDatv(i,J) = G%OBCmaskCv(i,J) * 2.0 / (Z_to_H * htot)
6653 else ! Both neighboring H points are masked out or this is an OBC face so IDatv(i,J) is unused
665419270 CS%IDatv(i,J) = 0.
6655 endif
6656 enddo ; enddo
6657 endif
6658
66591 call find_face_areas(Datu, Datv, G, GV, US, CS, MS, 1)
66601 if ((CS%bound_BT_corr) .and. .not.(use_BT_Cont_type .and. CS%BT_cont_bounds)) then
6661 ! This is not used in most test cases. Were it ever to become more widely used, consider
6662 ! replacing maxvel with min(G%dxT(i,j),G%dyT(i,j)) * (CS%maxCFL_BT_cont*Idt) .
66630 do j=js,je ; do i=is,ie
6664 CS%eta_cor_bound(i,j) = G%IareaT(i,j) * 0.1 * CS%maxvel * &
66650 ((Datu(I-1,j) + Datu(I,j)) + (Datv(i,J) + Datv(i,J-1)))
6666 enddo ; enddo
6667 endif
6668 !$omp target enter data map(to: CS%eta_cor_bound)
6669
66701 if (CS%gradual_BT_ICs) &
66710 call create_group_pass(pass_bt_hbt_btav, CS%ubt_IC, CS%vbt_IC, G%Domain)
66721 call create_group_pass(pass_bt_hbt_btav, CS%ubtav, CS%vbtav, G%Domain)
66731 call do_group_pass(pass_bt_hbt_btav, G%Domain)
6674
6675 ! id_clock_pass = cpu_clock_id('(Ocean BT halo updates)', grain=CLOCK_ROUTINE)
66761 id_clock_calc_pre = cpu_clock_id('(Ocean BT pre-calcs only)', grain=CLOCK_ROUTINE)
66771 id_clock_pass_pre = cpu_clock_id('(Ocean BT pre-step halo updates)', grain=CLOCK_ROUTINE)
66781 id_clock_calc = cpu_clock_id('(Ocean BT stepping calcs only)', grain=CLOCK_ROUTINE)
66791 id_clock_pass_step = cpu_clock_id('(Ocean BT stepping halo updates)', grain=CLOCK_ROUTINE)
66801 id_clock_calc_post = cpu_clock_id('(Ocean BT post-calcs only)', grain=CLOCK_ROUTINE)
66811 id_clock_pass_post = cpu_clock_id('(Ocean BT post-step halo updates)', grain=CLOCK_ROUTINE)
66821 if (dtbt_input <= 0.0) &
66831 id_clock_sync = cpu_clock_id('(Ocean BT global synch)', grain=CLOCK_ROUTINE)
6684
6685 ! send initialized data to GPU
6686 !$omp target enter data map(to: CS%bathyT)
6687 !$omp target enter data map(to: CS%D_u_Cor, CS%D_v_Cor)
6688 !$omp target enter data map(to: CS%dx_Cv, CS%dy_Cu)
6689 !$omp target enter data map(to: CS%IareaT, CS%IareaT_OBCmask)
6690 !$omp target enter data map(to: CS%IDatu, CS%IDatv)
6691 !$omp target enter data map(to: CS%IdxCu, CS%IdyCv)
6692 !$omp target enter data map(to: CS%OBCmask_u, CS%OBCmask_v)
6693 !$omp target enter data map(to: CS%q_d)
6694 !$omp target enter data map(to: CS%ua_polarity, CS%va_polarity)
6695 !$omp target enter data map(to: CS%ubtav, CS%vbtav)
6696
66972end subroutine barotropic_init
6698
6699!> Copies ubtav and vbtav from private type into arrays
67000subroutine barotropic_get_tav(CS, ubtav, vbtav, G, US)
6701 type(barotropic_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
6702 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Grid structure
6703 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G)), intent(inout) :: ubtav !< Zonal barotropic velocity averaged
6704 !! over a baroclinic timestep [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
6705 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G)), intent(inout) :: vbtav !< Meridional barotropic velocity averaged
6706 !! over a baroclinic timestep [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
6707 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
6708 ! Local variables
6709 integer :: i,j
6710
67110 do j=G%jsc,G%jec ; do I=G%isc-1,G%iec
67120 ubtav(I,j) = CS%ubtav(I,j)
6713 enddo ; enddo
6714
67150 do J=G%jsc-1,G%jec ; do i=G%isc,G%iec
67160 vbtav(i,J) = CS%vbtav(i,J)
6717 enddo ; enddo
6718
67190end subroutine barotropic_get_tav
6720

6722!> Clean up the barotropic control structure.
67231subroutine barotropic_end(CS)
6724 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Control structure to clear out.
6725
67261 call destroy_BT_OBC(CS%BT_OBC)
6727
6728 ! Allocated in barotropic_init, called in timestep initialization
67291 DEALLOC_(CS%ua_polarity) ; DEALLOC_(CS%va_polarity)
67301 DEALLOC_(CS%IDatu) ; DEALLOC_(CS%IDatv)
67311 if (allocated(CS%eta_cor_bound)) deallocate(CS%eta_cor_bound)
67321 DEALLOC_(CS%eta_cor)
67331 DEALLOC_(CS%bathyT) ; DEALLOC_(CS%IareaT)
67341 DEALLOC_(CS%frhatu) ; DEALLOC_(CS%frhatv)
67351 DEALLOC_(CS%OBCmask_u) ; DEALLOC_(CS%OBCmask_v)
67361 DEALLOC_(CS%IdxCu) ; DEALLOC_(CS%IdyCv)
67371 DEALLOC_(CS%dy_Cu) ; DEALLOC_(CS%dx_Cv)
6738
67391 if (allocated(CS%frhatu1)) deallocate(CS%frhatu1)
67401 if (allocated(CS%frhatv1)) deallocate(CS%frhatv1)
67411 if (allocated(CS%IareaT_OBCmask)) deallocate(CS%IareaT_OBCmask)
6742
67431 if (allocated(CS%q_D)) deallocate(CS%q_D)
67441 if (allocated(CS%D_u_Cor)) deallocate(CS%D_u_Cor)
67451 if (allocated(CS%D_v_Cor)) deallocate(CS%D_v_Cor)
67461 if (allocated(CS%ubt_IC)) deallocate(CS%ubt_IC)
67471 if (allocated(CS%vbt_IC)) deallocate(CS%vbt_IC)
67481 if (allocated(CS%lin_drag_u)) deallocate(CS%lin_drag_u)
67491 if (allocated(CS%lin_drag_v)) deallocate(CS%lin_drag_v)
6750
67511 if (associated(CS%debug_BT_HI)) deallocate(CS%debug_BT_HI)
67521 call deallocate_MOM_domain(CS%BT_domain)
6753
6754 ! Allocated in restart registration, prior to timestep initialization
67551 DEALLOC_(CS%ubtav) ; DEALLOC_(CS%vbtav)
67561end subroutine barotropic_end
