6758!> This subroutine is used to register any fields from MOM_barotropic.F90
6759!! that should be written to or read from the restart file.
67601subroutine register_barotropic_restarts(HI, GV, US, param_file, CS, restart_CS)
6761 type(hor_index_type), intent(in) :: HI !< A horizontal index type structure.
6762 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
6763 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
6764 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< A structure to parse for run-time parameters.
6765 type(barotropic_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Barotropic control structure
6766 type(MOM_restart_CS), intent(inout) :: restart_CS !< MOM restart control structure
6767
6768 ! Local variables
676958 type(vardesc) :: vd(3)
6770 character(len=40) :: mdl = "MOM_barotropic" ! This module's name.
6771 integer :: n_filters !< Number of streaming band-pass filters to be used in the simulation.
6772 integer :: isd, ied, jsd, jed, IsdB, IedB, JsdB, JedB
6773
67741 isd = HI%isd ; ied = HI%ied ; jsd = HI%jsd ; jed = HI%jed
67751 IsdB = HI%IsdB ; IedB = HI%IedB ; JsdB = HI%JsdB ; JedB = HI%JedB
6776
6777 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "GRADUAL_BT_ICS", CS%gradual_BT_ICs, &
6778 "If true, adjust the initial conditions for the "//&
6779 "barotropic solver to the values from the layered "//&
6780 "solution over a whole timestep instead of instantly. "//&
6781 "This is a decent approximation to the inclusion of "//&
6782 "sum(u dh_dt) while also correcting for truncation errors.", &
67831 default=.false., do_not_log=.true.)
6784
678569561 ALLOC_(CS%ubtav(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed)) ; CS%ubtav(:,:) = 0.0
678669742 ALLOC_(CS%vbtav(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB)) ; CS%vbtav(:,:) = 0.0
67871 if (CS%gradual_BT_ICs) then
67880 allocate(CS%ubt_IC(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed), source=0.0)
67890 allocate(CS%vbt_IC(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB), source=0.0)
6790 endif
6791
6792 vd(2) = var_desc("ubtav","m s-1","Time mean barotropic zonal velocity", &
67936 hor_grid='u', z_grid='1')
6794 vd(3) = var_desc("vbtav","m s-1","Time mean barotropic meridional velocity",&
67956 hor_grid='v', z_grid='1')
6796 call register_restart_pair(CS%ubtav, CS%vbtav, vd(2), vd(3), .false., restart_CS, &
67971 conversion=US%L_T_to_m_s)
6798
67991 if (CS%gradual_BT_ICs) then
6800 vd(2) = var_desc("ubt_IC", "m s-1", &
6801 longname="Next initial condition for the barotropic zonal velocity", &
68020 hor_grid='u', z_grid='1')
6803 vd(3) = var_desc("vbt_IC", "m s-1", &
6804 longname="Next initial condition for the barotropic meridional velocity",&
68050 hor_grid='v', z_grid='1')
6806 call register_restart_pair(CS%ubt_IC, CS%vbt_IC, vd(2), vd(3), .false., restart_CS, &
68070 conversion=US%L_T_to_m_s)
6808 endif
6809
6810 call register_restart_field(CS%dtbt, "DTBT", .false., restart_CS, &
68111 longname="Barotropic timestep", units="seconds", conversion=US%T_to_s)
6812
6813 ! Register streaming band-pass filters
6814 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "USE_FILTER", CS%use_filter, &
6815 "If true, use streaming band-pass filters to detect the "//&
68161 "instantaneous tidal signals in the simulation.", default=.false.)
6817 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "N_FILTERS", n_filters, &
6818 "Number of streaming band-pass filters to be used in the simulation.", &
68191 default=0, do_not_log=.not.CS%use_filter)
68201 if (n_filters<=0) CS%use_filter = .false.
68211 if (CS%use_filter) then
68220 call Filt_register(n_filters, 'ubt', 'u', HI, CS%Filt_CS_u, restart_CS)
68230 call Filt_register(n_filters, 'vbt', 'v', HI, CS%Filt_CS_v, restart_CS)
6824 endif
6825
682633end subroutine register_barotropic_restarts
6827

6829!> \namespace mom_barotropic
6830!!
6831!! By Robert Hallberg, April 1994 - January 2007
6832!!
6833!! This program contains the subroutines that time steps the
6834!! linearized barotropic equations. btstep is used to actually
6835!! time step the barotropic equations, and contains most of the
6836!! substance of this module.
6837!!
6838!! btstep uses a forwards-backwards based scheme to time step
6839!! the barotropic equations, returning the layers' accelerations due
6840!! to the barotropic changes in the ocean state, the final free
6841!! surface height (or column mass), and the volume (or mass) fluxes
6842!! summed through the layers and averaged over the baroclinic time
6843!! step. As input, btstep takes the initial 3-D velocities, the
6844!! initial free surface height, the 3-D accelerations of the layers,
6845!! and the external forcing. Everything in btstep is cast in terms
6846!! of anomalies, so if everything is in balance, there is explicitly
6847!! no acceleration due to btstep.
6848!!
6849!! The spatial discretization of the continuity equation is second
6850!! order accurate. A flux conservative form is used to guarantee
6851!! global conservation of volume. The spatial discretization of the
6852!! momentum equation is second order accurate. The Coriolis force
6853!! is written in a form which does not contribute to the energy
6854!! tendency and which conserves linearized potential vorticity, f/D.
6855!! These terms are exactly removed from the baroclinic momentum
6856!! equations, so the linearization of vorticity advection will not
6857!! degrade the overall solution.
6858!!
6859!! btcalc calculates the fractional thickness of each layer at the
6860!! velocity points, for later use in calculating the barotropic
6861!! velocities and the averaged accelerations. Harmonic mean
6862!! thicknesses (i.e. 2*h_L*h_R/(h_L + h_R)) are used to avoid overly
6863!! strong weighting of overly thin layers. This may later be relaxed
6864!! to use thicknesses determined from the continuity equations.
6865!!
6866!! bt_mass_source determines the real mass sources for the
6867!! barotropic solver, along with the corrective pseudo-fluxes that
6868!! keep the barotropic and baroclinic estimates of the free surface
6869!! height close to each other. Given the layer thicknesses and the
6870!! free surface height that correspond to each other, it calculates
6871!! a corrective mass source that is added to the barotropic continuity*
6872!! equation, and optionally adjusts a slowly varying correction rate.
6873!! Newer algorithmic changes have deemphasized the need for this, but
6874!! it is still here to add net water sources to the barotropic solver.*
6875!!
6876!! barotropic_init allocates and initializes any barotropic arrays
6877!! that have not been read from a restart file, reads parameters from
6878!! the inputfile, and sets up diagnostic fields.
6879!!
6880!! barotropic_end deallocates anything allocated in barotropic_init
6881!! or register_barotropic_restarts.
6882!!
6883!! register_barotropic_restarts is used to indicate any fields that
6884!! are private to the barotropic solver that need to be included in
6885!! the restart files, and to ensure that they are read.
6886
68870end module MOM_barotropic
